title: Creative Director - Paravel Insights
description:
Creative Director - Paravel Insights

**Creative Director**
=====================

**Location:** Remote, U.S. Based
  
**Type:** Full-Time Contract

**About Paravel Insights**
--------------------------

Paravel Insights is a strategy, marketing, and creative agency that exists to empower visionary and faith-based organizations. We partner with mission-driven clients across advocacy, education, nonprofit, political, and cultural spaces to help build meaningful movements and high-impact campaigns.

Our team thrives in fast-moving environments where strategy, creativity, and execution work hand in hand. We value excellence, initiative, adaptability, humility, and strong collaboration.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Paravel Insights is seeking an experienced, strategic, and visionary **Creative Director** to lead our creative department and oversee creative direction, strategy, development, and execution across our client accounts and campaigns.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for guiding the entire creative process, from initial strategy and conceptual development through design, copywriting, storytelling, film and video production, and final execution.

We are looking for someone who can see the big picture while maintaining a strong understanding of the details that make great work successful. The ideal candidate brings a combination of creative vision, strategic thinking, strong leadership, and hands-on expertise.

We need someone who can lead a multidisciplinary team, develop strong campaign concepts, oversee visual and written content as well as film and video, establish clear standards, and ensure everything produced by the department is strategically aligned and executed with excellence.

The right person will be comfortable leading creative conversations, presenting and defending ideas, making decisions, mentoring team members, and taking ownership of the department's performance and output.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Creative Department Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead and oversee Paravel's creative department, including design, copywriting, film and video, and related creative disciplines.
* Serve as the primary day-to-day leader of the department, providing clear direction, support, and accountability.
* Establish and maintain high standards for quality, consistency, collaboration, and execution.
* Provide mentorship, coaching, professional development, and performance feedback to team members.
* Partner with the Design Director to ensure strong visual leadership, effective design execution, and consistency across projects.
* Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment that encourages innovation, initiative, ownership, and excellence.
* Partner with executive leadership on department structure, staffing needs, resource planning, and long-term team development.
* Establish and improve workflows, review processes, and departmental practices that support both quality and efficiency.

### **Creative Vision, Strategy & Direction**

* Lead the development of compelling campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging approaches, and integrated creative strategies.
* Collaborate closely with strategists and account leads to translate client objectives, audience insights, and campaign strategies into effective creative solutions.
* Oversee concept development from initial brainstorming and strategic planning through final execution.
* Guide the creative direction of campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and platforms.
* Ensure that creative decisions are intentional, strategically grounded, and aligned with client goals.
* Bring fresh perspectives, original ideas, and innovative approaches to campaign development and creative challenges.
* Evaluate concepts and provide clear, constructive feedback that strengthens the work.
* Help identify opportunities to elevate campaigns, improve storytelling, and increase overall impact.
* Contribute to new business opportunities, pitches, presentations, and strategic planning initiatives.

### **Design, Copywriting, Film & Content Oversight**

* Provide leadership and direction across visual design, written content, film, and video, ensuring cohesive creative execution.
* Oversee brand identity development, campaign design, advertising creative, messaging, copywriting, film and video production, content development, and storytelling.
* Ensure that design, copy, and video work together to communicate clear, compelling, and strategically aligned messages.
* Ensure all campaign messaging, copywriting, and written communications reflect natural American English, appropriate cultural context, and the intended tone and voice for U.S. audiences.
* Provide creative direction for video campaigns, television commercials, digital advertising, branded films, and other video content from concept through final production.
* Collaborate with internal production teams, videographers, editors, directors, and external production partners to ensure a cohesive creative vision.
* Guide creative development across digital, print, social media, websites, film, video, advertising, presentations, events, and other campaign channels.
* Review and approve creative concepts, designs, messaging, scripts, storyboards, video treatments, and final deliverables for quality, accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment.
* Work closely with the Design Director to maintain high visual standards while providing overarching direction across the department.
* Lead copywriters in developing effective messaging, headlines, campaign narratives, advertising copy, scripts, and other written communications.
* Maintain a strong understanding of design principles, copywriting, brand strategy, visual storytelling, audience engagement, and multichannel execution.
* Provide hands-on creative guidance and contribute directly to concept development or execution when needed.

### **Campaign Development & Execution**

* Lead the creative development of integrated campaigns and initiatives from initial concept through launch.
* Oversee campaign identities, messaging frameworks, visual systems, content development, and supporting creative assets.
* Ensure a cohesive approach across campaign platforms, channels, and deliverables.
* Guide creative work for brand launches, awareness campaigns, fundraising initiatives, advocacy efforts, recruitment campaigns, advertising, and storytelling experiences.
* Oversee the creative direction of film and video projects, including concept development, scripting, storyboarding, production planning, and post-production review.
* Partner with production teams to ensure commercials and video content align with campaign strategy, messaging, and overall creative vision.
* Balance ambitious ideas with practical considerations, including budgets, timelines, resources, and client expectations.
* Collaborate with project managers and account leads to ensure projects move efficiently from planning to delivery.
* Identify challenges early, provide solutions, and help keep projects moving forward.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving strategies, and new client needs.

### **Quality Control, Accountability & Department Performance**

* Take ownership of the overall quality, consistency, and effectiveness of work produced by the department.
* Establish clear review and approval processes to maintain high standards across all deliverables.
* Ensure creative work aligns with approved strategies, client objectives, brand guidelines, and project requirements.
* Provide decisive, constructive feedback and ensure revisions strengthen the final product.
* Work closely with project managers to maintain accountability for deadlines, deliverables, and project milestones.
* Evaluate campaign performance, client feedback, and results to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify and implement improvements to creative workflows, team collaboration, and departmental efficiency.
* Maintain a high standard of excellence while empowering team members to take ownership of their responsibilities.

### **Cross-Department Collaboration & Client Leadership**

* **Reporting Structure:** Report directly to the Senior Marketing Strategist (Account Lead) and the Chief Operating Officer (Acting Executive Creative Director).
* **Department Leadership:** Directly oversee and lead the Design Director, designers, and copywriters, while providing creative direction and oversight for film and video production.
* Translate strategic direction from the Senior Marketing Strategist and executive creative direction from the COO into clear, actionable guidance for the creative team.
* Collaborate closely with executive leadership, senior strategists, account managers, project managers, and production teams.
* Serve as a key creative leader in internal planning, campaign development, and strategic discussions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, campaign reviews, and creative workshops.
* Present concepts confidently, communicate strategic rationale, and guide discussions with internal teams and clients.
* Build strong working relationships across departments to ensure alignment between strategy, creative development, and execution.
* Help bridge the gap between strategic vision and the practical work required to bring campaigns to life.
* Communicate proactively regarding creative needs, project challenges, priorities, and opportunities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Must be based in the United States and legally authorized to work in the U.S.
* Exceptional written and spoken English proficiency, with native-level fluency, is required.
* 8+ years of professional experience in creative, advertising, marketing, branding, or campaign development, preferably within an agency environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading creative teams, departments, or multidisciplinary creative initiatives.
* Proven ability to oversee design, copywriting, and film and video, with a strong understanding of how these disciplines work together.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative direction, integrated campaign development, brand strategy, advertising, storytelling, and high-quality execution.
* Experience developing and leading campaigns from initial strategy and concept through production and launch.
* Experience providing creative direction for film, video production, television commercials, digital advertising, or branded video content.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, scripting, production workflows, editing, and post-production, with the ability to guide specialized production teams.
* Strong understanding of branding, art direction, design, copywriting, content strategy, advertising, and multichannel marketing.
* Ability to translate complex strategies, audience insights, and organizational objectives into clear and compelling concepts.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and developing creative professionals while maintaining accountability and high performance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, organization, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and fast-moving projects without sacrificing quality.
* Comfortable collaborating directly with senior leadership, strategists, account teams, and clients.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to evaluate both the big-picture strategy and the finer details of execution.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and modern design and production workflows.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, or similar collaboration and project management tools preferred.
* Experience with web development, motion graphics, or emerging creative technologies is a plus.
* Experience working with advocacy, nonprofit, education, faith-based, or mission-driven organizations is a plus.

**Cultural Alignment**
----------------------

At Paravel, culture matters deeply. We are looking for someone who:

* Leads with confidence, humility, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Is proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented.
* Can inspire and develop team members while holding them accountable.
* Thinks strategically and creatively, always keeping the bigger objective in mind.
* Communicates clearly, professionally, and proactively.
* Is comfortable making decisions, providing direct feedback, and navigating challenges.
* Values excellence without allowing ego to get in the way of collaboration.
* Takes initiative and looks for opportunities to improve processes, ideas, and outcomes.
* Adapts quickly and works well in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
* Is comfortable supporting mission-driven and faith-based organizations and working across a variety of client perspectives and initiatives.

**Why Work With Paravel**
-------------------------

* Opportunity to lead and help shape the creative department of a growing, mission-driven agency.
* Meaningful leadership role with influence over creative direction, team development, and departmental performance.
* Opportunity to work on high-impact campaigns across branding, advocacy, advertising, film, video, media, and storytelling.
* Collaborative environment with direct access to executive leadership and strategic decision-making.
* Talented multidisciplinary team with opportunities to mentor, develop, and strengthen creative professionals.
* Variety of projects, clients, and campaigns that provide ongoing opportunities for new challenges and innovative thinking.
* Flexible remote work environment.
* Fast-moving agency culture that values initiative, excellence, collaboration, and strong leadership.

**To Apply**
------------

Please submit a resume, portfolio or portfolio link, and a short introduction outlining your experience and interest in the role.

We are especially interested in seeing examples of campaigns or initiatives you have led from strategy and concept through final execution, including integrated campaigns, branding, advertising, and film or video projects.

Please highlight one's experience leading creative teams, overseeing design and copywriting, directing film and video projects, developing integrated campaigns, and collaborating with senior leadership and clients.

This is a remote, U.S.-based position. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Exceptional written and spoken English proficiency is required.

Applications without relevant portfolio examples demonstrating creative leadership and campaign development may not be considered.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
------------

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore.

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are.

It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us. But most of the people who need us have never heard of us. By the end of 2027, we expect half of America's seniors will know who we are.

You will be the author of what they see. This isn't about directing a campaign. It's about building a courageous, iconic household brand close to scratch, with real budget and real creative license behind you. We aren't trying to rent attention. We want the kind of organic awareness that comes from people recognizing us, remembering us, and telling each other about us. If that's what you want to spend the next few years on, we'd love to talk.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* You will set our creative direction as we scale from <10% of American seniors and their families knowing about us to >50% in 2027. That’s millions of impressions. Super-bowl-commercial scale.
* You'll decide how Community Phone looks everywhere it shows up: TV, paid social, web, direct mail, the box, and our social channels. A family should recognize the same brand whether they see us at 9pm on TV or open the box at mom's house.
* You will be the steward of our brand, ensuring all platforms, from paid ads to customer newsletters, meet our brand standards.
* You'll take the brand identity system our design agency is launching in mid-October and make it world-class. Their work is the starting point. Scaling it across every surface and pushing it further is your job.
* You'll do the real work yourself. You'll design the website, the box, and the pieces that define us, and you'll be excited to make things rather than just advise on them.
* You'll build the creative machine for paid social and guarantee the quality of its output.
* You'll own creative performance alongside growth. Beautiful work that doesn't move CAC isn't done yet.
* You'll build the team that scales the brand with you.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You have 8+ years in creative direction, and you've built a phenomenal consumer brand.
* You have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative work across digital, retail, social, packaging, experiential, film, photography, and product storytelling.
* You have both agency and in-house experience. You know how to get great work out of a studio, and you know what it takes to live with a brand every day.
* You grew up on the visual side of creative direction (art direction, design, motion), and you have real experience leading copy and concept too.
* You still love making the work. Your best days are the ones where you're designing, not sitting in review meetings.
* You believe in the power of AI in creative work. You use it every day, you know where it makes the work better, and you're excited about what it makes possible next.
* You've made creative that performs at scale, ideally across TV, paid social, and physical.
* You have experience managing production budgets, agencies, freelancers, and complex creative programs.
* You have excellent taste.
* You have superlatively high humility, intelligence, and hunger. Great creative reveals truths that were already there. It is a pursuit of truth just as much as a pursuit of beauty. The people who can do it seem to possess these three qualities to a high degree.
* You have the judgment to operate as the entire creative function today, and you want to push and be pushed by the growth team.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've designed packaging and unboxing for a consumer hardware or DTC product.
* You've worked on eldercare, health-adjacent, or other trust-sensitive consumer brands.

**How we work**
---------------

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to our Cofounder who runs Revenue and Operations, and you'll have a very direct line from your work to customers who will tell you, often within the same day, whether you got it right.

**How to apply**
----------------

Send us your portfolio, including the consumer brand you're proudest of building and what happened to it in market. Tell us briefly why building a brand for this kind of customer is interesting to you.

title: Creative Director
description:
EverOn Data Center Services is seeking a highly creative, strategic, and execution-oriented Creative Director to lead the development and implementation of the company's visual identity and creative initiatives across all marketing, sales, and corporate communications channels, including video production, podcast development, and multimedia storytelling.

As a key member of the Marketing & Sales team, the Creative Director will be responsible for translating EverOn's business objectives, brand positioning, and marketing strategies into compelling visual and multimedia experiences that strengthen brand recognition, support business development, and communicate the company's expertise in the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

This individual will serve as the organization's internal creative authority, ensuring brand consistency, design excellence, and high-quality execution across digital, print, presentations, proposals, events, video, podcasts, and other customer-facing materials. The Creative Director will also lead the creative development and production of video and podcast content, from concept and production planning through recording, editing, and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative vision with strong project management capabilities and a hands-on approach to design, video, audio, and multimedia production. This role requires the ability to balance strategic creative thinking with day-to-day execution in a fast-paced, growing organization.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Creative Direction & Brand Management**

* Lead the creative direction and visual execution of EverOn's brand across internal and external communications.
* Serve as the primary steward of EverOn's visual identity, ensuring consistent application of brand standards across all channels and materials.
* Translate company positioning, business priorities, and marketing objectives into impactful creative concepts and visual communications.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, design systems, templates, and creative standards as the company grows.
* Establish and uphold standards for design quality, visual storytelling, multimedia production, and creative consistency.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand differentiation through innovative design and creative execution.
* Collaborate with the Chief Customer Officer to ensure creative initiatives align with overall business, marketing, and commercial strategies.

### **Creative Development & Production**

* Lead and execute the design and production of marketing, sales, and corporate communication materials.
* Develop and oversee creative assets, including:

  + Corporate presentations and executive communications
  + Proposal and RFP design elements
  + Digital and social media graphics
  + Website graphics and digital assets
  + Advertising and promotional material design
  + Event branding, signage, and environmental graphics
  + Case studies, infographics, and thought leadership design
  + Corporate videos, project videos, interviews, and promotional content
  + Podcast episodes, promotional clips, and supporting creative assets
  + Motion graphics, animation, and multimedia content
* Ensure all creative deliverables meet brand standards, quality expectations, and established deadlines.
* Adapt creative assets across multiple platforms, audiences, and formats while maintaining visual consistency.
* Oversee final artwork preparation, production specifications, and coordination with external vendors when necessary.
* Maintain an organized and accessible library of creative assets, templates, photography, video footage, audio recordings, and approved brand materials.

### **Video Production, Podcast Development & Multimedia Storytelling**

* Lead the creative development, production, and post-production of video and podcast content that supports EverOn's marketing, thought leadership, employer branding, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the marketing team, executive leadership, subject matter experts, and agency partners to develop video and podcast concepts aligned with established content strategies and business priorities.
* Plan and coordinate video shoots, podcast recordings, interviews, project footage, and other multimedia production activities.
* Direct or execute filming, audio recording, editing, motion graphics, sound design, and post-production activities.
* Develop and maintain consistent visual and audio branding for EverOn's video and podcast programming.

* Create short-form video clips, promotional trailers, audiograms, and other supporting assets to extend the reach and value of long-form content.
* Identify emerging multimedia formats, production technologies, and creative approaches that enhance EverOn's storytelling capabilities.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agency Coordination**

* Work collaboratively with the Chief Customer Officer, marketing team, sales organization, executive leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the marketing team in the execution of campaigns, brand initiatives, corporate events, and digital marketing programs.
* Collaborate with internal content owners to translate approved messaging into visually engaging materials.
* Ensure creative work is aligned across internal teams and external partners while minimizing duplication of effort.

### **Creative Operations & Project Management**

* Manage the creative production process from initial concept through final delivery.
* Establish clear creative briefs, project timelines, production schedules, and approval workflows.
* Prioritize creative requests based on business impact, urgency, available resources, and established marketing priorities.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows, standardize processes, and increase production efficiency.
* Maintain visibility into creative project status, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Ensure appropriate version control, file organization, and accessibility of final creative assets, including video and audio content.
* Evaluate and recommend creative tools, technologies, production equipment, and processes that improve quality and productivity.
* Provide guidance and creative feedback to internal contributors while fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment.

### **Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

title: Creative Director
description:

The Creative Director leads creative strategy, brand identity, and creative operations for High Profile's marketing organization. This role directs creative across every channel, with depth in paid and organic social, and builds AI-enabled systems that let the team scale. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at a strategic altitude while simultaneously able to get hands-on needed, doing the work and setting an example when needed. The Creative Director works with autonomy and brings fully formed recommendations to the VP of Marketing.

**JOB DUTIES:**

Core duties and responsibilities include the following.

**Creative Strategy & Brand Stewardship**

* Accountable for creative direction across every channel and format, including in-store, wholesale support, internal packaged brands, traditional media, paid digital, and organic social. Set the bar and give final creative approval before work goes to the VP of Marketing or other stakeholders.
* Lead creative ideation for tentpole campaigns. Facilitate brainstorms with marketing teams to generate the strongest ideas in the room. Set the creative throughline for each initiative: the core idea, tone, visual direction, and example executions, as inspiration for channel directors to build strategies against.
* Serve as the primary steward of brand identity across all channels once standards are established, holding the internal team and any outside partners or agencies accountable to them.
* Bring an external point of view on creative quality, benchmarking High Profile's output against strong work in retail, CPG, and adjacent categories, and raising the team's overall craft bar.

**Channel Expertise & Growth Channels**

* Define a high quality standard for High Profile's paid advertising creative across digital and traditional media, including display, paid social, video, direct mail, and out-of-home. Produce to that standard across all operating states and their compliance rules.
* Own creative direction and content quality for paid digital and organic social, partnering with the Digital team, which owns channel strategy, targeting, and media spend, to ensure content performs and reflects brand standards.
* Lead creative concepting for campaign and initiative-level work, including seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives, and new channel launches.
* Lead the Design Manager on creative direction for traditional media, maintaining quality and consistency in High Profile's highest-spend traditional channels.

**Creative Operations & Systems**

* Own and rethink High Profile's highest-volume recurring production processes, beginning with the weekly promotional workflow, identifying opportunities to reduce manual production time through AI-assisted tools and improved systems.
* Evaluate and implement AI and workflow tools across the creative team to increase throughput and creative capacity without adding headcount.

**Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic direction, workload prioritization, and professional development to the creative and design team.
* Build a scalable, well-documented creative operating model that teaches frameworks for creative thinking, brief writing, and critique.
* Report on creative team performance, capacity, and initiative progress to the VP of Marketing. Owns creative & design budget and manages to target.
* Builds productive working relationships within marketing and with cross-functional partners: buying & planning, retail, compliance, wholesale, and facilities.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Leads a team of four: Design Manager, Production Packaging Designer, Senior Graphic Designer, and Graphic Designer. This role directly manages the Design Manager, Packaging Designer, and Graphic Designer. Creative Director will also direct external paid media agencies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

* 6+ years in creative roles, with at least 3 years as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or equivalent.
* 3+ years at an integrated, full-service, or brand agency in a concept-leading role (copywriter, Design Manager, ACD, or CD), creating campaign ideas rather than only producing assets.

* Portfolio with integrated work from concept through execution across three or more channels.

* Strong, current point of view on social-native content, ideally with experience connecting content quality to measurable performance.
* Experience building or improving creative production systems and workflows, familiarity with AI-assisted workflows strongly preferred.
* Experience managing a creative or design team of 3+ people.
* Experience leading brainstorms or concept development with cross-functional partners who don't report to them, with examples of ideas others built out across channels.
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and bringing proactive recommendations to leadership.
* Cannabis or other regulated industry experience a plus, but not required.

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

**What you'll do:**

NinjaTrader is hiring a Creative Director to own how the company looks, sounds and feels across every marketing surface a consumer encounters. This is the senior-most creative role in the marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO.

Our brand strategy and positioning are sharp, but the visual expression lags behind.. This is an opportunity to level up our visual identity to reflect the dynamic and growing nature of the brands we have in market. Then your job is to make it real — operationalize it, extend it into the places it doesn't yet reach, and defend it as volume scales. After that, you own the creative standard for the group.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, and you will still be in the file. We are not hiring someone to run a review calendar.

Trading is a category of noise: identical charts, identical claims, identical stock photography of men in headsets. The mandate is to make NinjaTrader unmistakable.

**In this role you will:**

The marketing identity system

* Operationalize the incoming brand identity system — typography, color, photography and illustration direction, motion language, iconography, layout systems — and extend it into the surfaces it does not yet cover
* Own the marketing design system: build it to scale across campaign, web, lifecycle and partner surfaces, and to hold up when other hands use it
* Establish the governance that keeps the system intact — standards, documentation, review, and the authority to say no
* Act as the final quality gate on brand expression across marketing

Creative output and storytelling

* Concept and direct integrated campaigns from brief to launch — video, social, paid, OOH, sponsorship, events
* Develop the narrative, not just the look. You will shape the story a piece of video tells, then art-direct the production that delivers it
* Own marketing web and landing page design, including the pages that carry acquisition and conversion volume
* Direct lifecycle and product marketing creative so the experience stays coherent from first impression to funded account
* Stay personally in the work on hero projects — concepting, designing, writing direction, cutting with the editor

Team and partners

* Hire, manage and develop a small in-house design team; set the critique culture and the standard
* Brief, direct and evaluate agencies, production partners and freelancers; own creative quality of outsourced work
* Build the operating rhythm — briefs, reviews, handoffs — that lets a small team ship at volume
* Grow into broader creative ownership over time, including copy and video production

Cross-functional leadership

* Partner with Product Design on shared brand guidelines so marketing and platform surfaces stay recognizably the same brand. Product Design owns the product design system; you own the marketing one. The two are deliberately scoped differently and should stay that way
* Work with performance marketing to build creative that is testable, iterable and measured against funnel outcomes
* Operate fluently inside a regulated marketing environment, partnering with compliance early rather than treating review as a downstream tax

* 8+ years of brand and creative experience, with 2+ years leading a team as an ACD, CD or design lead
* A portfolio built on systems, not one-offs
* Storytelling range — able to develop narrative, not only art-direct someone else's script
* Range across brand campaign work and performance creative
* A desire to remain hands-on — actively driven to stay in the work, not just direct it
* Fluency with AI tooling in the creative process
* A track record of managing designers and directing external agencies
* Comfort with performance data

* Fintech, brokerage, trading, crypto or exchange experience, or genuine curiosity about markets and retail traders
* Experience operationalizing an inherited identity system rather than only building from scratch
* Experience running a marketing design system alongside a separately owned product design system
* Experience in a constrained or regulated environment — finance, healthcare, insurance, pharma or gaming
* Practicing a craft outside the day job — photography, film, writing or illustration
* Agency background plus in-house leadership experience

title: Engineering Director, EU
description:
***We're on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We're waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We're not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid)

### **Engineering at Monzo**

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

**What you'll work on**

* Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
* Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
* Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
* Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
* Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
* Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
* Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
* Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
* Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

### **You should apply if**

* You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
* You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
* You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
* You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
* You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
* You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
* You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
* You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
* You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

### **The interview process**

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:

* **Initial Call (1 hour)** You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They'll ask example based questions ('Tell me about a time when…')

* **Loop Stage** - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we'll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you're interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

  

**How we work :**

**Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) :**

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there's no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

**Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.**

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You'll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

### **What's in it for you**

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences

#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE

**Equal opportunities for everyone**

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we're making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we're embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
description:
**About the opportunity**
=========================

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

### **In this role, you will**

* **Drive the Core ML Platform Vision:** Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
* **Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios:** Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
* **Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure:** Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
* **Establish Model Evaluation and Governance:** Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
* **Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance:** Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
* **Elevate and Mentor the PM Function:** Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

### **What you need to be successful**

#### **Background & Experience**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
* **High-Volume B2C Scale:** Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
* **Strategic & Portfolio Leadership:** Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

#### **Technical & Domain Skills**

* **Deep ML and MLOps Literacy:** Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
* **Analytical and Evaluation Rigor:** Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
* **Latency and System Trade-Offs:** Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
* **Financial Governance and Compliance:** Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

#### **Traits**

* **Platform Visionary:** Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
* **Decisive Technical Leader:** Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
* **Uncompromising Quality Standard:** High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

### **What's in it for you**

* Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe's premier digital banks.
* Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
* A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
* An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

### **Who we are**

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

**Sounds good? Apply now for this position.**

### **Equal Opportunities**

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Wind Turbine Driveline Systems
description:
The successful candidate will be a part of GE Vernova’s Wind Global Machine Head Driveline subsystem. The team is responsible for mechanical hardware (main bearing, main shaft, covers, rotor locks, rotor brakes, and couplings) including New Product / Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis for utility scale wind turbines.
  
  
This position will primarily support the high speed rotor lock, rotor brake, and flex coupling through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, validation, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**The Opportunity**

Wind turbine reliability is engineered before a single blade turns — in the design of the rotor brakes, locks, and couplings that have to perform for decades in some of the most demanding environments on earth. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at GE Vernova, you will own the full design lifecycle for Machine Head Driveline subsystem components across the wind turbine fleet: from specification and analysis through validation testing, root cause investigation, and standardization across the global product portfolio.

This is a role for someone who combines deep mechanical design expertise with the judgement to make consequential decisions independently — and the collaborative instinct to bring manufacturing, sourcing, quality, and field teams along with them.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead component design and development** — design build-to-spec rotor brakes & couplings and build-to-print rotor locks for wind turbines; own component specification design, system interaction analysis, and reliability verification through physical testing; drive new product introduction and new technology integration from concept through to validated production release.

* **Own design quality and documentation standards** — ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs (Bills of Materials), and specifications in accordance with GE Vernova and industry processes; own and drive lessons learned, design best practices, and standardization into design practices, drawings, and technical specifications.

* **Develop and execute validation plans** — design testing and validation programs to prove component function and reliability; resolve field issues through root cause analysis and identify design-based corrective actions that prevent recurrence.

* **Solve cross-functional manufacturing and field issues** — work closely with quality, manufacturing engineering, sourcing, suppliers, and field support teams to improve product quality and FTY (First-Time Yield); provide design-based corrective actions for NCR (Non-Conformance Report), SDR (Supplier Deviation Request), and PAC (Product Acceptance Criteria) issues.

* **Identify and execute cost and technology improvements** — identify and deliver cost-saving strategies; introduce advanced materials, manufacturing methods, and design tools to advance the strategic position of Driveline subsystem components within the broader wind turbine portfolio.
  

**About You**

You are a senior mechanical engineer with extensive experience in component design, analysis, and validation for rotating or power generation equipment — comfortable operating with a high degree of independence while driving outcomes across global, cross-functional teams. You are also experienced working with suppliers and manufacturing processes to ensure your design is consistently produced with high quality.

**Required**

* A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar discipline.

* Major experience in mechanical analysis and design in an industrial or product engineering environment.

* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and manufacturing processes.

* Proficiency in 3D CAD (Computer-Aided Design) tools — specifically Unigraphics / Siemens NX.

* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across different geographies and cultural contexts.

* Clear communication, project management, and interpersonal skills — with the ability to present complex technical findings to diverse audiences.

* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering.

* Experience in design and/or application of mechanical components in the powertrain of rotating equipment.

* Working knowledge of ANSYS or other FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools.

* Experience in design or product development of mechanical components in wind turbines or other power generation products.

* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) / DFI (Design for Installation) / DFS (Design for Serviceability) methodologies.

* Exposure to PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) processes and tools.

* Track record of collaborating with product managers and suppliers to optimize component costs and shape purchasing strategy.
  

**Why GE Vernova**

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In this role, you will contribute directly to the reliability and performance of wind energy technology that operates at scale across the global fleet — supported by a team that values engineering rigour, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

We provide varied, competitive benefits designed to reward high performers and support your personal and family needs. GE Vernova invests in your continued on-the-job learning and development and provides a clear path for career growth within a global organization.

title: Strategic Account Manager (Growth)
description:
**The Dcycle Vision.**
----------------------

Every company will be profoundly impacted by the adoption of artificial intelligence over the next five years. The companies that make the most of this shift will gain a competitive advantage over the rest.

AI models are already capable of automating a large part of business operations and processes. The problem is that companies are not yet ready to unlock that potential. For AI to be truly useful, it needs context. Today, however, information remains scattered across spreadsheets, systems, suppliers, and departments, making it difficult for AI to understand the business and act effectively.

Dcycle solves this. We bring financial, operational, and supply chain data together in a single, trusted source of truth, enabling teams and AI agents to work from the same data.

### **Your Role: Strategic Account Manager (Growth)**

You own the growth of around 40-50 key Dcycle customers in Spain, and you share with the team a wider portfolio of smaller accounts. Your job is to help each of them get more value from Dcycle and buy more: new modules, new sites and new buyers inside the company, from procurement and IT to finance and general management. You run quarterly business reviews with key accounts, take complex topics (a new regulation, a market benchmark, a technical use case) and explain them simply, and open doors to the management committee and to our international team. You report to the Head of Sales Spain.

#### ***What Your First Months Will Look Like***

**You'll hit the ground running.** In your first weeks you'll learn the product inside out (automated data collection, multi-framework reporting, product LCA, supplier engagement, ISO management systems and Leia, our built-in AI), meet your portfolio together with Customer Success and map each account: who buys, what they use and what they are missing.

**By month three,** you'll have account plans for your key customers, you'll have run your first QBRs and closed your first expansion deals, including our new products for quality and procurement teams.

**By month six,** you'll be selling to buyers outside sustainability in several accounts and you'll be on track with your quota.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the expansion of your 40-50 key accounts (upsell, cross-sell, new sites and new buyers), and work the shared portfolio through Customer Success signals and campaigns.
* Prepare and run quarterly business reviews with key accounts: results, benchmarks against their sector, upcoming regulation and next steps.
* Research complex topics (new regulations, market benchmarks, technical use cases), simplify them and present them so that a CFO or a plant manager gets it in five minutes.
* Sell our newer products, such as ISO management systems and supplier evaluation, to procurement, IT, finance and quality teams.
* Take relationships up to the management committee, and connect international customers with our international team.
* Work hand in hand with Customer Success: they own adoption and renewal, you own growth.
* Keep your pipeline and forecast up to date in HubSpot, and use AI to research, build benchmarks and prepare your QBRs.

### **Soft Skills: How we work**

At Dcycle, your title no longer describes everything you do. Speed changed our culture: anyone can build, and AI agents multiply what each of us gets done. We expect three things from everyone who joins:

* **You build your own solutions.** When you find a problem, you don't wait for someone else to fix it. You design the solution, build it and put it into the world, whether it is a playbook, an automation or an agent that does part of the work.
* **You keep learning.** What you know today isn't enough for tomorrow. You pick up new disciplines and areas of knowledge so that no problem or obstacle stops you.
* **You are honest and accountable.** You share what you are building before you build it, you own the outcome and not just the output, and you say things as they are.

For this role we also need you to be a **great communicator**: you turn something complex into a clear story, and you are comfortable presenting it to a management committee.

We are managers of one and many: we run our own work and we orchestrate AI agents to multiply it. In return, the company removes bureaucracy and protects good-faith mistakes.

### **Technical Skills**

Minimum Requirements

* 5-8 years in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years in account management, expansion or customer-facing sales at C-level.
* A track record of growing accounts and hitting expansion targets.
* You have sold to procurement, IT, finance or general management.
* You write and present very well, and you have run QBRs or presentations to management committees.
* You understand technical use cases well enough to explain them; you don't need to configure them.
* You already use AI in your daily work. We will ask you to show us how.
* Languages: bilingual Spanish and English.

We value skills that include:

* A degree in engineering, environmental science, economics or similar.
* Knowledge of ESG, quality management (ISO), procurement or supply chain.
* Experience with industrial or food and beverage companies.

We’re not just looking for experience; we’re looking for people with a growth mindset who can drive innovation and challenge the status quo.

### **Salary & Benefits**

* Competitive base DOE + uncapped variable. The more you grow your accounts, the more you earn.
* 23 paid vacation days
* 7 days of team-building per year
* Flexible compensation through Factorial: meals, transport and childcare, taken out of gross salary
* Subsidized training for continuous development
* Flexible work schedule

  + Start anytime between 8:00-9:30 AM
  + Leave anytime between 5:30-7:00 PM (Monday-Thursday)
  + Finish at 3:00 PM on Fridays

### **Hybrid Work Model**

* First month: Onsite (to immerse yourself in the team and product)
* After that: 3 days in our Madrid office, 2 days remote each week
* Extra remote days for parents, long commutes
* Full remote work (optional) from the end of Summer team building until September warm-up week, and from the end of Winter team building through to January 6th.
* Start date: between November 2026 and January 2027

### **Interview Process**

We have a thorough but efficient hiring process:

* **Screening Call:** A short intro call where we explain Dcycle and the role, confirm your availability, salary alignment and walk you through timelines.
* **Interview with Talent:** Your first real conversation, sharing your story, motivation, and experience so we can get to know you and set you up for the next steps.
* **Interview with the Hiring Manager:** A deep-dive with the CRO testing your hard and soft skills through detailed examples and probing follow-ups.
* **Values Interview:** A chat with a Values Champion to understand how you live a specific Dcycle value in practice and test your cultural fit with the company.
* **Interview with Operations:** A practical session that stress-tests your resilience, attention to detail, and consistency, ending with time for your questions.
* **Interview with the Founders:** A final conversation to confirm mutual fit, trust, and that you’ll help raise Dcycle’s talent bar.

### **FAQ**

### **What’s the hiring process like?**

It’s tough but fair. We want to make sure you’re a great fit, so we’ll assess your technical skills, values, and potential. We provide feedback within 2 days and aim to move quickly.

### **How can I prepare for the interview process?**

We recommend reviewing the job description thoroughly, researching our company culture, and preparing for both technical and behavioral interview questions. Practice technical tasks to be ready for any technical rounds.

### **Can I apply if I’m outside of Spain?**

If you have a valid work permit for Spain and are willing to relocate to Madrid, we’re happy to consider your application. We don’t sponsor visas

### **Can I apply for multiple positions at once?**

Yes, you are welcome to apply for multiple positions that align with your skills and interests. We will assess your suitability for each role and reach out if there's a match.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike's Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike's AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

**Role Scope:**

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike's agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

**MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:**

* Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
* Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
* Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
* Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

**Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:**

* Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
* Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
* Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

**What You Will Help Shape:**

* A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
* GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
* A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

### **Your Impact:**

* Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers' existing ecosystems.
* Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
* Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
* Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
* Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
* Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
* Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

**Why This Role Is Unique:**

* You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
* You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
* The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

### **What's Next?**

* Introduction Call with a Recruiter

* Conversation with the AI Product Director

* Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

* Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
### **About ExoClick**

ExoClick is an innovative and global ad company serving 20 billion daily geo-targeted ads to web and mobile advertisers & publishers. We are part of EXOGROUP, a set of companies made up of +200 talents and offering a wide range of services within the digital business landscape with headquarters in Barcelona and offices in Dublin, Porto and Valencia.

We are revolutionizing the online ad-serving industry for advertisers, publishers, and networks alike and are seeking to recruit a Performance Media Buyer for our Barcelona office.

### **Role**

As Performance Media Buyer, you will work with global performance-based online advertisers across a wide variety of verticals within the adult entertainment industry. You will actively create, monitor and optimize campaigns for a portfolio of clients (both assigned and newly qualified leads) with a particular focus on effective inventory monetization, delivering a first-class service and sharing best practices within the various internal departments. Your daily tasks will also involve data analysis, preparing strategic client reports, proposals and contracts.

Together with a cross functional team, you will participate in development on new products and new marketing angles. As a top-notch media buyer you should educate and coach new media buyers in developing advertising strategies and campaigns. You will report to the Sales Director.
