title: Senior Client Solutions Manager - Influencer Marketing (6 Month FTC) | Europe
description:
**About Kyra**
--------------

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Europe (Remote) | 9-month Fixed-Term Contract  
Competitive, dependent on experience  
  
**The Opportunity**

You will be the day-to-day owner of one of Kyra's largest and most complex global enterprise accounts: a fast-moving, multi-category consumer brand with 12+ sub-brands, 35+ active stakeholders, and campaigns running simultaneously across multiple regions.

Your job is to keep delivery tight, keep the client happy, and be a safe pair of hands on a flagship account. This is not about growing or expanding the account. The commercial relationship is locked in. The job is world-class servicing at enterprise scale.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the global account relationship across 12+ sub-brands and multiple regions. Stay organised across a volume of comms, briefs, and stakeholders that is genuinely unusual.
* Orchestrate cross-functional teams: creative, paid media, creator partnerships, and product. You are the connective tissue. If something drifts, you see it early and fix it.
* If something drifts (performance, scope, relationship, or timeline) you see it early and fix it. No surprises. Steady, organised ownership.

**Lead the Relationship** Own client relationships across product launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programmes. Multi-thread across their teams. Build trust at every level. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

**Turn Insight into Strategy** Translate campaign data into clear, executive-level recommendations using AI to move from raw numbers to narrative faster. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

**Own Delivery End-to-End** Lead client onboarding for new briefs: build decks, verify SOW accuracy, coordinate internal teams, demo the platform. Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across our full product suite, including Always-On creator partnerships, Pulse campaigns, Makers (CGC), Amplify+ (paid boosting), Seeding+, and License+. With 6+ briefs running simultaneously, operational precision is everything. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

**Protect & Grow Revenue** Lead post-campaign analysis: run internal post-mortems, build PCA decks, present performance narratives. Own exec-ready reporting (QBRs/EBRs). Reporting should inform decisions, not just recap them.

**Keep the System Tight** Keep tracking clean. Watch capacity. Fix what's inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn't get lost. Feed client insights back into product development.  
  
**Feed Insight Back into Product** Surface client needs, pain points, and feature requests back into the product team. You are the closest person to how the client actually uses the platform.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who has:

* 4–6+ years in influencer or creator marketing
* Campaign execution experience. You have actually run creative marketing activations, not just managed client relationships from a distance.
* Enterprise account servicing at scale. Multi-stakeholder, high-volume, complex. You have managed accounts with this many moving parts before.
* Exceptional organisation. The volume of comms, briefs, regions, and stakeholders on this account is unusually high. Getting lost is easy. You don't get lost.
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset. You take ownership of learning, build internal relationships proactively, and don't wait to be told what to do.
* Strong hands-on campaign experience, with real fluency in TikTok.
* AI fluency, applied. Our platform is AI-powered and you'll be expected to get up to speed fast and use it daily for client summaries, performance narratives, and campaign analysis. We're looking for people already comfortable using AI tools in their workflow, so the learning curve is the platform, not the concept.
* Comfortable working across project management tools (Asana, Airtable, Slack) and reporting dashboards.
* CPG or multi-category consumer brand experience is a plus.

You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the accounts you've managed.

**Traits That Matter**
  
Proactive. Organised. Adaptable. Self-starting. Comfortable with ambiguity.

You don't wait for problems to land. You see them coming and act. You don't need rigid processes or hand-holding. Tools, product, and ways of working evolve constantly here, and you thrive on that.

You're willing to say "I don't know" and go find out. You take feedback well. You build trust fast.

**What Success Looks Like** **What Success Looks Like**
  
  
**By Month 1:** You have full context on all active sub-brands, briefs, and stakeholders. You've built a strong working relationship with the Campaign Director and the internal pod. The client knows your name and trusts you to run things.

**By Month 3:** Delivery is running smoothly across all regions. You own reporting and client comms without oversight. Post-campaign analysis is sharp and drives clear recommendations. Internal teams come to you, not around you.

**By Month 6:** The account is in better shape than when you arrived. Stakeholder satisfaction is high. Nothing has been dropped. Leadership trusts your judgement completely.  
  
**Benefits**

Hybrid working. 3 days per week in-office, 4 days during your first 2 weeks of onboarding.  
**Annual Time Off:** 25 days PTO (pro-rated) + bank holidays (pro-rated), 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year  
**Growth:** Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills.  
**Rewards:** Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

**Support**

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our **privacy policy**.

title: Editor, Marketing
description:
**About Darkroom**

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Video Editor on Darkroom’s internal Marketing Team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the visual storytelling behind our brand. You'll work closely with our Video Lead, Design Lead, and Director to transform raw content into engaging, high-impact videos for platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is a fast-moving, creative, and collaborative role for someone with sharp instincts, strong technical skills, and a passion for crafting content that connects with audiences.

In this role, you’ll develop a scalable, high-output video content engine that fuels Darkroom’s brand voice. You’ll design a creative system for rapid, high-quality production across channels, repurposing standout moments from podcasts, events, and behind-the-scenes footage. With a performance-driven approach to storytelling, you’ll adapt quickly to platform shifts, experiment with new formats, and continuously refine output based on real-world results.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Social-First Video Editing**

* Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
* Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
* Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
* Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
* Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
* Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
* Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
* Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on what drives reach, engagement, and conversion.
* Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
* Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

### **Production Excellence**

* Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
* Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
* Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
* Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
* Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
* Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

**You’re a Great Fit If You:**
------------------------------

* Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
* Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
* Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
* Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YT Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
* Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
* Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
* Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
* Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

### **Bonus Points If You:**

* Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
* Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
* Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

**What it's like to work at Darkroom**

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

* Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
* Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
* Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
* Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
* Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

**This role is currently a Talent Pool, which means we are not actively interviewing — but plan to do so in the near future. We want to be transparent and cognizant of your time.**

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

title: Global Revenue Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Description**

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever-increasing disruption caused by technology-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage.

We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

 **Job Description**

**QAD** is seeking a **Global Revenue Marketing Manager** to own and execute strategic go-to-market campaigns and drive pipeline generation globally. This role is based in EMEA (Spain/UK preferred) and reports to the Director of Revenue Marketing.

This role sits within the Revenue Marketing team and partners closely with the Director of Revenue Marketing and the broader Revenue Marketing organization to set strategy, run integrated campaigns, and deliver pipeline contributions globally.

This role is responsible for deciding and developing *both customer and new logo* revenue campaigns, focusing on industry-specific campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and drive measurable revenue impact across QAD's manufacturing solutions portfolio.

You will partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, and global channel partners to run multi-channel GTM motions, from account-based strategies to broad-based demand generation, executing against the global pipeline plan set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Marketing.

*This remote role requires 10–15% travel to represent and align marketing strategies at key industry gatherings, including Champions of Manufacturing (CoM) events, annual Sales Kickoffs, and integrated marketing planning meetings.*

**What You’ll Do**

* Decide and develop customer and new logo revenue campaigns, with a focus on industry-specific campaigns, in partnership with the Director of Revenue Marketing
* Run strategic GTM motions, including ABM, digital campaigns, and webinars, aligned to global pipeline goals
* Build and execute integrated campaigns (email, digital, webinars, ABM) targeting priority accounts and segments globally, across both customer and new logo audiences
* Execute and participate in industry conferences and trade events to drive brand visibility, lead generation, and account engagement globally
* Support execution of customer events and programs, driving registrations, engagement, and pipeline follow-up
* Partner with Sales and Business Development to align campaigns with territory plans, account priorities, and pipeline targets
* Work with global channel partners to extend campaign reach and drive co-marketing pipeline contribution
* Coordinate with the Product Marketing team on shared messaging, positioning, and campaign assets, ensuring consistent global execution
* Drive demand generation and pipeline acceleration programs tailored to industry and regional market dynamics and buyer behavior
* Develop segmentation and targeting recommendations by industry, geography, and buying stage
* Deliver against pipeline and revenue targets (Sales Accepted Opportunities, pipeline contribution) globally
* Track pipeline performance from campaign inception through to revenue, flagging funnel risks to the Director and Sales
* Partner with Sales to improve conversion and progression where opportunities are stalling
* Maintain pipeline hygiene and SLA accountability, ensuring timely follow-up, clear stage progression, and accurate data capture across all marketing-generated opportunities
* Report on weekly campaign performance, recommending spend and optimization adjustments
* Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps on data, reporting, and campaign execution; maintain dashboards to track pipeline, conversion, and ROI
* Work with Localization teams to adapt messaging and GTM programs across global languages and markets

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing required**, with a proven track record of driving demand generation, pipeline growth, and measurable revenue impact. ERP industry experience is a plus.
* **GTM & ABM Strategy:** Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies and account-based marketing programs aligned with business priorities, target accounts, and revenue goals.
* **Self-starter and proactive approach** is required to enable working both independently but also collaboratively.
* **Integrated Campaigns:** Proven ability to plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across email, paid media, digital advertising, events, webinars, and sales-driven programs.
* **International Experience Required:** Demonstrated experience executing marketing programs across international markets, adapting campaigns and messaging to regional business needs.
* **Sales & Marketing Alignment:** Strong ability to collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, and regional teams to accelerate pipeline and drive revenue growth.
* **Data-Driven Marketing:** Strong understanding of marketing KPIs, funnel conversion, campaign attribution, pipeline contribution, and ROI to optimize performance.
* **Marketing Technology & AI:** Proficiency in Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, digital marketing tools, and emerging AI-powered technologies. Experience with Google Workspace required.
* **Project Management & Execution:** Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* **Collaboration & Ownership:** Results-oriented, creative, proactive, and adaptable, with excellent communication skills, strong accountability, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams.

 **Additional Information**

**Compensation Package:**

* Base pay range: 65,000 EUR - 70,000 EUR (12 Months) base salary
* Placement within our pay range will vary based on knowledge, skills, experience, and market location variations as well as internal peer equity.
* This role is eligible for the Marketing Bonus Plan.

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Senior Tech Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
#### **About Qualifyze,**

Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,500 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

#### **Role Overview:**

We’re looking for a **Senior Talent Acquisition Partner with strong experience in tech hiring** to join our People team and take ownership of Talent Acquisition across Qualifyze, partnering with stakeholders across our business. You’ll be touch the full recruitment cycle and areas

**The challenge?** Going beyond filling roles. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to Hiring Managers, combining your recruitment expertise with data and market insights to shape hiring strategies in collaboration with the Head of People, , challenge assumptions and attract the right talent.

You’ll also have the autonomy to improve how we hire, from optimising processes and enhancing the candidate experience to exploring new sourcing approaches and strengthening our employer brand. We’re looking for someone proactive and hands-on who enjoys navigating change and balancing hiring delivery.

You’ll be part of a People team of seven, working closely with our Talent Acquisition Intern.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* Own the end-to-end recruitment process across Tech & Data, Product, Growth, Finance and Quality, translating business needs into effective recruitment plans and sourcing strategies.
* Act as a trusted advisor and partner to Hiring Managers, providing guidance on talent availability, role requirements, compensation expectations and recruitment best practices, while managing expectations and ensuring alignment throughout the process.
* Use recruitment data and talent market insights to guide day-to-day decisions, build reports on key hiring metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve sourcing strategies and hiring outcomes.
* Optimise recruitment processes, workflows and tools, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and collaboration through new approaches and technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
* Ensure a high-quality candidate and Hiring Manager experience throughout the recruitment process, maintaining a consistent approach and a high bar for quality.
* Strengthen Qualifyze’s employer brand and position the company as an attractive place to work through targeted talent attraction initiatives.

#### **Main requirements:**

* **You know your way around Talent Acquisition:** +5 years experience managing end-to-end hiring in a fast-paced environment, ideally in a scale-up or international company. Comfortable juggling several roles at once, prioritising effectively and adapting when business needs change.
* **Tech hiring is your thing:** Hands-on experience hiring across technical teams, including Frontend and Backend Engineers, DevOps, Data Engineers, Data Scientists and BI profiles. No need to be an engineer, but confidence discussing technical requirements with Hiring Managers and understanding what makes a good fit is key.
* **A data-driven approach:** Comfortable working with recruitment metrics and building hiring reports, spotting bottlenecks and turning insights into better hiring decisions and outcomes.
* **You know how to challenge a hiring brief:** Able to build trust with Hiring Managers, ask the right questions and challenge assumptions when needed, keeping hiring strategies grounded in business priorities and what the talent market can realistically offer.
* **Always looking for better ways to hire:** With a continuous improvement mindset, you’re always looking for ways to make recruitment more effective, whether it’s refining a sourcing strategy, simplifying a workflow or exploring new tools and technologies, while improving the experience we offer candidates.
* **Ownership and business acumen:** Things move quickly at Qualifyze, so this role calls for someone who takes initiative, makes sound decisions independently and connects recruitment priorities to wider business goals. Strong business acumen and the ability to focus on what will make the biggest difference are essential.
* **You stay on top of your work:** proactive and organised, with a good handle on priorities and follow-ups. Someone who takes accountability for their work, anticipates what needs attention and keeps others in the loop so people know they can count on you.

**Salary**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **45,000€ - 50,000 €**.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What do we offer?**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
‍* ️Country specific benefits offering incl. private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a human-led hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription.

All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze we actively support the power of diversity, uniting complementary talents and perspectives to address new challenges. Our collective strengths help us to find innovative solutions and turn difficulties into opportunities. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs and feels heard.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

title: Head of Global Events and Travel (100% REMOTE)
description:
The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

* **Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events** (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);
* **Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel** (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and
* **Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management**.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

**Responsibilities**

* **Function Leadership:** Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.
* **Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events:** Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.
* **Internal Meetings & Offsites:** Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.
* **Travel Operating Model Transition:** Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.
* **Corporate Travel Oversight:** Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.
* **Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship:** Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.
* **Financial Governance & Client Billing:** Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.
* **Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships:** Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.
* **Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management:** Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.
* **Cross-Functional & Client Partnership:** Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.
* **Events & Travel Leadership:** 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.
* **Client & Internal Event Expertise:** Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).
* **Large-Scale Event Execution:** Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.
* **Travel Program Transformation:** Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.
* **Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency:** Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.
* **Financial & Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated budget ownership, financial forecasting, ROI tracking, vendor negotiations, and client event billing/cost recovery. Experience with virtual-card systems or modern payment settlements is a plus.
* **Executive & External Presence:** Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-Suite executives, enterprise clients, sponsors, and key industry partners.
* **Data Privacy & Duty of Care:** Solid understanding of global travel safety protocols, crisis management, GDPR compliance, vendor DPAs, and attendee data privacy standards.
* **Language & Mobility:** Professional fluency in English (Spanish and/or Italian are strong pluses). Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% and operate across European, Middle Eastern, and Americas time zones.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

--------------

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. ### **Job Description**

**YOUR MISSION**

At Glovo, we are looking for a passionate, strategic Sr. Lead FCF planning to join our Finance Performance department at our Barcelona headquarters. Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A / Finance Performance Director, you will own the global Free Cash Flow planning ecosystem across 21+ markets, translating complex multi-entity P&L and Balance Sheet dynamics into trusted, forward-looking cash forecasts. Over the next 12–18 months, your mission is to transform our spreadsheet-based FCF modeling architecture into a highly accurate, driver-based forecasting engine, partner with C-level leadership on strategic capital allocation, and drive proactive working capital initiatives to safeguard liquidity and fund expansion—all while acting as the functional manager and technical mentor for our FCF Sr. Analyst.

**THE JOURNEY**

* Own the global multi-entity FCF forecasting and rolling plan framework end-to-end in complex spreadsheets, ensuring dynamic integration with P&L, Balance Sheet, and working capital drivers across 21+ operating markets.
* Master the navigation of enterprise FP&A tools (Anaplan, OneStream) and ERPs (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics) to seamlessly pull, interrogate, and reconcile Actuals and P&L planning inputs into the core spreadsheet FCF model.
* Act as the practical manager and mentor for the FCF Sr. Analyst, reviewing their analytical outputs, guiding their professional development, and establishing robust operational redundancy during critical forecasting and closing cycles.
* Drive proactive liquidity optimization initiatives (partnering with Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and local operations to unlock cash pipelines).
* Act as the primary bridge to local Finance teams to capture, challenge, and refine country-level operational inputs; drive a unified FCF forecasting methodology by benchmarking regional models, scaling best practices, and implementing standardized driver-based templates across all entities.
* Serve as the primary finance counterpart for Delivery Hero (DH) Group on all FCF, liquidity, and cash projections; ensure seamless alignment on corporate methodology, reporting standards, and strategic cash flow inputs for group-level consolidation.
* Serve as the primary operational bridge and strategic partner between FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Delivery Hero central finance, constructively challenging operational assumptions and presenting FCF risks/sensitivity scenarios directly to C-level executives.
* Design robust simulation models to stress-test the FCF impact of major corporate or business decisions.

  

### **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE**

* Fluency in English
* 8+ years of progressive professional experience in Corporate Finance, FP&A, or Strategic Finance, with a heavy specialization in Cash Flow planning and liquidity modeling.
* Expert-level spreadsheet modeling capabilities (Excel / Google Sheets): proven track record of building and maintaining integrated 3-statement financial models from scratch across complex, multi-currency legal structures.
* Deep, non-negotiable understanding of technical accounting principles, balance sheet mechanics, and operational cash drivers (specifically DPO, DSO, and inventory cycles). You know how accounting entries flow across the three statements and how operational shifts translate directly into working capital and cash impact.
* FP&A & ERP Systems Navigation: working fluency in navigating enterprise FP&A tools (Anaplan, OneStream) and major ERPs (SAP, MS Dynamics) to interrogate upstream financial data, P&L planning outputs, and actuals.
* Demonstrated leadership & Coaching ability: proven experience guiding, mentoring, and reviewing the work of mid-level analysts, with the ability to set high analytical standards and direct daily priorities effectively without needing formal administrative authority.
* Deep financial & Accounting mastery: thorough understanding of corporate accounting principles, balance sheet dynamics, working capital drivers (DSO, DPO, inventory), and indirect/direct cash flow mechanics.
* Proven track record of value creation: demonstrated ability to go beyond reporting to identify, quantify, and execute tangible cash-generation opportunities.
* Exceptional communication & C-Level influencing: ability to translate complex cash dynamics into clear executive narratives, challenge cross-functional assumptions, and align senior leadership.

* Spanish language
* Prior experience in high-growth Tech, E-commerce, or capital-intensive/marketplace business models.
* Familiarity with advanced analytics tools (SQL, Python) or BI visualization platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

title: MATH Faculty Member - MATH
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: Math JD**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Language courses: Approximately 15-18 students
* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students
Lab courses: Typically fewer than 25 students  

**Why Join Verto?**  
***The below are for full-time Employees in the United States (benefits for international staff benefits vary by location and meet or exceed local standards)***

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation reimagining higher education
* ✈️ Work in a globally-minded, international environment
* Exposure to cross-functional teams (academics, operations, student life)
* Opportunity to grow in a fast-moving, impact-driven organisation

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Compensation**  
At Verto, base salary is one part of your total compensation package.

Final base pay will depend on your location (aligned to Verto’s compensation regions), as well as your experience, skills, and relevant qualifications. Your recruiter/hiring manager can share the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

**On-site - Seville** **— Anticipated Base Salary Range**  
€900–€1,200 per credit. MATH courses are typically 3 or 4-credit courses.  
  

* **️ Right to Work**

You must have the legal right to work in Spain. Verto Education is unable to sponsor visas for this role.  
  

* **Accessibility & Accommodations**

Verto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities. If you require support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  

**Data Privacy**

By applying for this role, you acknowledge that Verto Education will process your personal data for recruitment purposes. This includes assessing your application, communicating with you, and managing the hiring process. Your data will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where applicable.

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Verto Education is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic, including race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Faculty Member - CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming
description:
**Seville Faculty Member: CSCI 1110/1111 Introduction to Programming**

On-site - Seville | Verto Education  
Learn more about us:  
https://vertoeducation.org/abroad-locations/study-abroad-spain/

**About Verto**

Verto is on a mission to provide the best possible start to college. We make travel and experiential education a core part of the first year, enabling students to begin their academic journey overseas before transferring to one of 70+ partner universities in the United States.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
* Accurately calculate and submit grades on-time through the LMS and via the Academic Provider’s grade reporting software (Banner), following established mid-term and end-of-term grade reporting timelines and protocols. Respond to student inquiries related to their grades in a timely manner including any grade disputes or discrepancies after the final grading period.
* Foster learning environments that are respectful and positive, conducive to early college student development, adhere to Verto values, and that are characterized by learner-centered approaches to instructional design and delivery:
  + Helping students develop their academic identity and foundational academic skills with appropriate levels of challenge and support
  + Appropriate use of professional language and tone, modeling constructive feedback and conflict negotiation
  + Active classroom management and consideration of power dynamics in faculty-student relationships
  + Auditing course materials for representation for diverse student populations by including bringing in local and global perspectives through course readings, assignments, and activities.
* Build and maintain positive, collaborative, and professional relationships with program participants, staff, and community partners.
* Share feedback with local and global Verto academic leaders to provide recommendations for academic excellence and faculty support needs.
* Participate in curriculum development projects and assessment initiatives as directed by the University of New Haven and Verto Edcuation.
* Other duties as reasonably assigned.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Master’s degree required, terminal degree (PhD) in English Language or a closely related field preferred.
* Minimum eighteen graduate credits in the field of study relevant to the course(s) of interest.
* A minimum of two years of teaching experience in the English language with at least one year teaching at the university level.
* Demonstrated success in teaching students with varied learning styles and abilities.
* Appreciation for, and proven record of, success in working with students of diverse economic, racial, cultural, and educational backgrounds.
* Openness to feedback and application of strategies for continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfort level implementing policies and classroom standards that align with established policies and protocols.
* Passion for active, experiential, reflective and discussion-based learning and helping students make meaning out of their experiences.
* Eager to learn from colleagues and enjoys open collaboration and teamwork.
* Must have the legal right to work in the country for the full program duration, prior to the start of the semester. Verto Education does not sponsor visas or permits of stay.
  

**Who We’re Looking For**

The successful candidates are highly collaborative. They prioritize engaged teaching practices and will work closely with team members within and across global Verto locations, including the Program and Academic Director(s), Academic Managers, and local and global staff, to provide comprehensive student care. Candidates achieve excellence in teaching and learning to support a diverse student body. Faculty are an integral part of helping new college students build appropriate academic skills and will integrate academic skill building into courses and help identify growth opportunities for learners.

Candidates must be dynamic educators who are motivated by working with a first-year student population and building professional relationships with students and peers to support student engagement and academic success. Faculty will participate in academic and professional development training prior to, and throughout, the semester to support teaching and learning. Faculty are required to utilize the established academic policies and daily reporting tools for attendance, as described. All faculty will develop and lead active and experiential learning activities as part of the curriculum.

* Faculty who are intellectually curious and motivated, and are skilled in teaching concepts in various settings (e.g., in or outside of the classroom).
* Faculty who demonstrate genuine care about students and ability to connect and engage students in learning.
* Faculty who are willing to go that extra mile to support students' success in their start to their new college career.
* Faculty who excel at and love teaching, and are also willing to learn from their students and colleagues.
* Faculty who are versatile and flexible to meet dynamic and changing environments.
* Faculty who demonstrate high levels of professionalism and commitment and are open to continuous learning and development.
* Verto seeks faculty who can be a bridge to the local culture and help bring learning to life for students above all else.
  

**Application Instructions**

To apply, please submit the following:

* Cover Letter - a letter of interest (no more than 2 pages) that articulates your experience and qualifications in relation to the job description. Please share your specific experience with US higher education and higher education systems in the country where you are applying to teach, and share examples of active and experiential learning and how you support diverse learners' needs.

* Current Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* References - Names and contact information of three references who will provide a professional recommendation.
* Unofficial transcripts of graduate work. If your graduate degree was conferred from an institution that doesn’t traditionally issue transcripts, please upload a scanned copy of your diploma.
* Teaching evaluations from related courses / up to three separate semesters, if available.

Faculty will be asked to share a schedule of availability and complete a background check as part of the hiring process. All faculty are subject to final review and approval by the University of New Haven.
  
  
**Enrollment Sizes & Course Details**

Course assignments are typically 45 hours (3 U.S. credits) or 60 hours (4 U.S. credit) courses, depending on the course and discipline (4 credit/60 hours are typical for Lab or Studio based courses).

Faculty may be invited to teach multiple sections of the same course, when possible, and/or multiple courses directly related to their academic field of expertise, if related courses are available.

Course syllabi are developed and approved by the Academic Provider, along with specific information regarding course learning outcomes, academic policies, assessment of learning, and overall expectations. Faculty typically develop their own teaching materials, including schedule, readings, assignments, experiential learning activities, and develop and manage a course site via the Learning Management System, Canvas. Some courses are delivered in a sequential manner (e.g. BIOL I & II) or offered across all locations (e.g. ENGL 1112) and may have required course textbooks, common assignments or assessments, or other materials that are standard for course delivery.

Section enrollment varies by program location, scheduling, student enrollment, and classroom size. Specific information will be provided by the local program staff.

* Language courses: Approximately 15-18 students
* Non-language courses: Approximately 15-24 students
Lab courses: Typically fewer than 25 students  

**Why Join Verto?**  
***The below are for full-time Employees in the United States (benefits for international staff benefits vary by location and meet or exceed local standards)***

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation reimagining higher education
* ✈️ Work in a globally-minded, international environment
* Exposure to cross-functional teams (academics, operations, student life)
* Opportunity to grow in a fast-moving, impact-driven organisation

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Compensation**  
At Verto, base salary is one part of your total compensation package.

Final base pay will depend on your location (aligned to Verto’s compensation regions), as well as your experience, skills, and relevant qualifications. Your recruiter/hiring manager can share the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

**On-site - Seville** **— Anticipated Base Salary Range**  
€900–€1,200 per credit.  
  

* **️ Right to Work**

You must have the legal right to work in Spain. Verto Education is unable to sponsor visas for this role.

Verto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to candidates with disabilities. If you require support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

  

**Data Privacy**

By applying for this role, you acknowledge that Verto Education will process your personal data for recruitment purposes. This includes assessing your application, communicating with you, and managing the hiring process. Your data will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where applicable.

Verto Education is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. title: BIM Modeller - AI Product Platform
description:
**About the role:**

**About Janus Digital** Janus Digital ™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. We earn only on the additional value we create. Built on 15+ years of R&D, 76 granted patents and US$100M+ invested, the platform is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities with Fortune Global 500 owners, sovereign funds and hospitality groups.

**Strategic Context** Every building we make intelligent starts with accurate information about how it is built. High-detail BIM models, and MEP models in particular, are the foundation for digital twins, predictive maintenance and autonomous building operations. Janus Digital is now building its own AI BIM platform to create, check and enrich these models far faster than traditional workflows allow.

This role sits at the centre of that effort. You will deliver production-grade MEP and commercial BIM models using AI tooling to speed up every step, while giving the Chief Platform/Product Officer a practitioner's view of the AI-for-AEC market and the requirements our own platform must meet.

**Position Overview** We seek an experienced BIM Modeller specialising in MEP and commercial buildings, reporting directly to the Chief Platform/Product Officer. This hands-on role combines high-detail model delivery with structured market research into AI tooling and platforms, directly guiding the build of the Janus AI BIM platform.

Your time will split roughly 60% production BIM and 40% platform intelligence. You will model to LOD 350-400 under ISO 19650, measure the time AI and automation save against manual baselines, evaluate emerging AI tools on real project data, and translate real modelling workflows into product requirements, datasets and acceptance criteria.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce federated MEP models (HVAC, plumbing and drainage, fire protection, electrical, ELV and low-current systems) for offices, retail, hospitality, mixed-use and data-centre projects
* Model to LOD 350-400, including fabrication-ready ductwork, pipework, containment, hangers and supports where required
* Build and maintain parametric Revit families, shared parameters and project templates aligned to Janus Digital standards
* Run clash detection in Navisworks and BIM Collaborate Pro across architectural, structural and MEP models
* Apply AI and automation across the modelling workflow: auto-routing, family generation, drawing and sheet automation, model checking and scan-to-BIM
* Write and maintain Dynamo and pyRevit/Python scripts, using AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build them faster
* Map the AI-for-AEC landscape and run structured, hands-on evaluations of shortlisted tools on real Janus Digital project data
* Work closely with the Chief Platform/Product Officer to shape platform priorities from a practitioner's perspective
* Apply ISO 19650 information management: BEPs, MIDPs/TIDPs, naming conventions and CDE workflows
* Work with the Product team on developing an AI automation BIM tool.
* Highly skilled in testing and trailing new AI tool kits to build.

  
**Requirements**

**Experience**

* 6+ years of BIM modelling, with at least 4 years focused on MEP in commercial projects
* Portfolio of coordinated LOD 350+ MEP models on at least 3 delivered commercial projects
* Proven delivery on ISO 19650 projects, including multi-disciplinary clash coordination
* Demonstrable use of scripting or AI tools to speed up modelling, with before-and-after evidence

**Technical Expertise**

* Expert in Autodesk Revit (MEP); proficient in AutoCAD
* Navisworks Manage, clash detection and BCF issue tracking
* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 and BIM Collaborate Pro
* ISO 19650, BEP/MIDP/TIDP, Uniclass or OmniClass classification and IFC export
* Dynamo scripting and working knowledge of Python
* Daily use of LLM assistants for scripting, documentation and research

**Core Competencies**

* Precision: models are right first time, with clashes and data errors caught before issue
* Builder mindset: automates any task done more than twice and shares the tool with the team
* Critical evaluation: tests AI vendor claims on real data and reports results without hype
* Product thinking: turns modelling pain points into clear problem statements the product team can build against

**Preferred Qualifications**

* pyRevit, Revit API (C#), Grasshopper / Rhino.Inside or Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs
* Hands-on experience with AI-for-AEC tools in generative design, auto-routing, drawing automation, AI model checking or scan-to-BIM
* Point cloud import and modelling to scan
* Fabrication parts (Revit Fabrication / MEP Fabrication) and data-centre or healthcare services experience
* Solibri, Revizto or BIMcollab; COBie, IDS and bSDD; Dubai Municipality BIM e-submission experience
* Prior work at a software, PropTech or construction-tech company, or on an internal digital tools team

  
**Benefits**

This role can be based in our UAE office or fully remote, within a 4hr/+- window of Gulf Standard time

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

**YOUR MISSION**

At Glovo, we are looking for a passionate, strategic Sr. Lead FCF planning to join our Finance Performance department at our Barcelona headquarters. Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A / Finance Performance Director, you will own the global Free Cash Flow planning ecosystem across 21+ markets, translating complex multi-entity P&L and Balance Sheet dynamics into trusted, forward-looking cash forecasts. Over the next 12–18 months, your mission is to transform our spreadsheet-based FCF modeling architecture into a highly accurate, driver-based forecasting engine, partner with C-level leadership on strategic capital allocation, and drive proactive working capital initiatives to safeguard liquidity and fund expansion—all while acting as the functional manager and technical mentor for our FCF Sr. Analyst.
