title: Director of Content
description:
**Role Description**

The Director of Content is the senior content leader for Proxa and its portfolio of agencies. This role oversees the entire content department and is responsible for shaping and executing content strategies that grow our clients' online visibility and drive measurable business results.

The Director of Content is responsible for building a single, high-performing content team that operates the same way across every one of our brands and clients. This includes unifying two content teams into one, establishing the department's career path, setting the standard for quality and efficiency, and partnering closely with the Director of SEO so that content and SEO work as one engine for client results.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Director of Content will continue producing content for a reduced portfolio of clients while leading the team, serving as a key liaison between the content team, internal stakeholders, and clients, and driving innovation in how we produce content.

Every Director at Proxa owns the results, the health, and the growth of their department. These expectations apply to all Directors across Proxa, regardless of function. Directors are responsible for the overall performance, development, and success of their department. They serve as the department’s subject matter expert, proactively improving processes, identifying gaps, and building systems that support continued growth. Directors are accountable for achieving department KPIs, maintaining a healthy team culture, and developing employees through training, career paths, and ongoing feedback. They are expected to lead proactively, hold their teams accountable, and ensure their department continues to operate effectively as Proxa grows.

**Responsibilities**

**First 90 Days: Content Team Consolidation**

Within the first 90 days, establish and begin executing a plan that includes:

* Auditing both content teams' workflows, tools, templates, briefs, QA steps, turnaround times, and output
* Meeting with every team member, the Director of SEO, Account Managers, and Project Managers to understand what works and what does not
* Comparing client results produced by each team, including rankings, traffic, conversions, and client satisfaction
* Selecting the most efficient, highest-performing practices from each team and defining one unified content operating model
* Identify three metrics used to determine the quality of work
* Building standard processes for briefs, research, writing, editing, SEO integration, client review, and publishing
* Designing the content department career path, including levels, role expectations, competencies, and criteria for advancement
* Consolidate our two content teams into one team with a single, standardized way of operating
* Presenting the consolidation plan and career path to the COO for approval, then rolling both out to the full team

By day 90, the unified process should be in active use, not just documented.

**Department Leadership & Team Management**

* Serve as the supervisor for all content team members, ensuring they meet individual and team performance objectives
* Delegate projects and client assignments effectively to balance workload and foster a collaborative work environment
* Collaborate with the COO to establish and refine the department's operational processes, and business strategy

**Content & SEO Partnership**

* Partner closely with the Director of SEO to align content and SEO strategy, workflows, and priorities
* Ensure content is built to maximize client visibility across traditional search, local search, and AI-driven search
* Co-own shared processes, including keyword research handoffs, content briefs, on-page optimization, and performance reporting
* Resolve cross-team friction quickly and keep both teams focused on shared client outcomes

**Content Strategy & Production**

* Develop and implement content strategies that integrate SEO best practices, improve website performance, and drive customer engagement
* Develop and write compelling sales copy that drives conversions, while training and coaching content team members on effective sales copywriting techniques and best practices.
* Conduct research to build in-depth knowledge of client industries, customer personas, and consumer trends, with emphasis on home services and legal
* Create and maintain content specifications that align with each client's brand voice and customer personas
* Strategize and develop content pillars and sub-pillars to ensure a coherent editorial approach
* Oversee content calendars across all clients, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with client goals
* Produce content for a reduced portfolio of clients, modeling the quality and process standards set for the team

**Client Communication**

* Serve as the senior content expert in client meetings, presenting strategies, providing insights, and addressing questions or concerns
* Support account managers on escalations, retention risks, and strategic conversations involving content
* Collaborate closely with internal teams to support healthy, long-term client relationships

**Quality Assurance & Performance Analysis**

* Develop and enforce governance guidelines for tone, style, and voice across all content
* Own the editorial QA process so all content is client-ready before review, and facilitate collaboration during client review
* Continuously evaluate content performance and strategy to drive improvements in delivery and promotion
* Own content accuracy and quality across all client work, ensuring every piece is original, client-specific, and free of errors before it is published.
* Establish and track a KPI for content accuracy, such as the rate of content approved without revisions or corrections, and report on it regularly to leadership.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of content strategies against client goals and use performance data to adjust recommendations, priorities, and content approaches.

**Innovation & Trends**

* Stay current on technology, search, digital marketing, and legal industry trends and their implications for content
* Lead the adoption of AI tools and workflows that improve efficiency and quality without sacrificing accuracy or brand voice
* Monitor how search engines and AI platforms surface content and adapt the team's approach accordingly

**Department Development**

Take ownership of the continued growth and improvement of their department. Serve as the go-to resource and subject matter expert for their department, proactively identifying gaps, improving processes, and developing systems that support efficiency, consistency, and scalability. Directors should continuously evaluate how their department operates and take initiative to make improvements as the company grows, rather than waiting for issues to arise.

Strategic Planning: Develop and maintain a clear direction for the department that aligns with Proxa's overall goals. Proactively identify future needs, opportunities, and challenges, including staffing, technology, and process improvements.. Directors should be thinking beyond current operations and preparing their departments for what comes next.

Financial Authority: Directors do not have financial decision-making authority within their departments. All monetary decisions, including expenditures, staffing costs, and financial commitments, remain the responsibility of executive leadership.

Cross-Department Collaboration: Work closely with other Directors and departments to improve communication, address shared challenges, and ensure processes work effectively across Proxa. Take ownership of resolving issues that impact multiple departments rather than allowing them to become someone else's problem.

**Department KPIs**

Each Director owns three primary KPIs for their department, and one of the three, for client-facing departments (Web, Online Visibility, Ads, Content, Brand, Account Management, and PR), must be client retention. KPIs are proposed by the Director and approved by their supervisor.

**Requirements for every KPI:**

* Measurable: a number with a clear formula and data source, not a judgment call.
* Owned: the department can move it through its own work.
* Targeted: a baseline, a target, and a timeframe are set at approval.
* Reported: tracked on a shared dashboard and reviewed monthly.

**The retention KPI**

* Client-facing departments (Web, Online Visibility, Ads, Content, Brand, Account Management, and PR) track **client retention** tied to their work, such as logo churn, revenue retention, or churn attributed to their service line.
* Internal departments (finance, operations, HR) track **team retention**, measured as voluntary turnover over a rolling 12 months.
* All Directors also report team turnover as part of team health, even when their primary retention KPI is client-based.

**Team Health and Culture**

Directors are responsible for spotting burnout and overload before it shows up as turnover or missed work. That means watching real signals, not waiting for someone to raise their hand.

**Signals every Director monitors:**

* **Workload:** accounts, projects, or tickets per person against the department's capacity standard.
* **Hours and after-hours activity:** consistent late nights or weekend work are a flag, not a badge.
* **PTO usage:** team members who haven't taken time off in 6+ months get a conversation.
* **Engagement:** a short pulse survey each quarter, with results shared with the team.
* **Turnover and exit themes:** reviewed with Talent after every departure.

**What Directors are expected to do:**

* Set and publish a capacity standard for each role (for example, accounts per AM or projects per developer).
* Rebalance work, push back on scope, or raise a hiring need when the team is over capacity.
* Address behavior that damages the team quickly and directly, regardless of the person's performance.
* Escalate retention risks on key people to their executive leader early, not at resignation.
* Recognize good work publicly and regularly.

**Training and Development**

Directors build the systems that make their team better and less dependent on any one person, including themselves.

* **Onboarding:** maintain a documented 30/60/90 day onboarding plan for every role in the department.
* **SOPs:** keep core processes documented and current, reviewed at least twice a year.
* **Ongoing training:** run at least one team training session per month, led by the Director or a team member.
* **Individual growth:** every team member has written development goals, reviewed monthly in 1+1s.
* **Career paths:** Own the development, maintenance, and implementation of their department’s career path using the Proxa career path framework. Regularly evaluate where each employee falls within the career path, provide honest feedback on their progress and areas for development, and identify when employees have met the criteria and are ready for promotion.
* **Succession:** identify at least one person who could step in for the Director's key responsibilities.

**Operating Rhythm**

Every Director runs the same core cadence so the leadership team always knows where each department stands.

Daily - Team Huddle: 10-15 minutes: Priorities, blockers, capacity check

Weekly - 1+1 with each direct report: 30 minutes: Workload, growth, early warning on burnout

Weekly - KPI Report: Automated: Three KPIs vs. target, team health signals, actions

Monthly - Team Training: 30-60 minutes: Skill building, process updates

Quarterly - Pulse survey and review: Written: Engagement results, development goals, KPI reset if approved

Daily huddles stay short and standing. Directors with teams in heavy client-meeting schedules may run an async daily check-in instead, with executive approval.

**How Directors Are Evaluated**

Directors are reviewed on results and on how they lead, weighted equally.

**What is measured**

Results (50%)

Performance on the three department KPIs against approved targets

Leadership (50%)

Team health, employee development, department improvements, process development, strategic planning, and cross-department collaboration

Missing a KPI target is not automatic underperformance if the Director flagged the risk early and acted on it. Hitting targets while burning out the team is not a strong performance.

Baseline Expectations (All Employees)

* Employee shall also perform the reasonable duties requested by the Employer in order to further the Employer's Business.
* The use of AI tools is a required part of this role. Employee is expected to actively leverage AI to improve efficiency and outcomes in their responsibilities and to remain current on emerging tools and capabilities relevant to their work.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a Content Strategist
* Minimum of 3 years of people management experience, including hiring, performance reviews, and developing direct reports
* Proven experience building or standardizing content processes across a team
* Strong working knowledge of SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and local SEO
* Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment
* Experience presenting content strategy to clients and managing client expectations
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in content research, production, and QA

**Preferred Profile**

* Agency experience creating content for home services contractors and/or law firms
* Experience leading a team through a merger, consolidation, or major process change
* Experience designing career paths, leveling frameworks, or training programs
* Familiarity with GEO/AEO and how content is surfaced in AI-driven search
* Proficiency with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics

**Benefits**

* 401(k) with employer matching
* Health, dental, vision, and life insurance
* Paid time off

Why Proxa

Proxa is the centralized operations company supporting Array Digital, Rival Digital, and a growing portfolio of agencies. We exist to bring clarity, discipline, and scalability to growing agencies. We value transparency, urgency, quality, winning, and passion. This role offers a rare opportunity to build a unified content department the right way, shape how our agencies deliver results, and directly impact the growth of the clients we serve.

Pay: $89,250.00 - $120,750.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Content development: 7 years (Preferred)
* Management: 3 years (Preferred)

title: Director of Safety
description:
Honor Technology's mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor's growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world's leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Director of Safety to build and scale safety strategy for our distributed in-home care workforce. In this role, you will own reducing injury rates and severity, reducing workers' compensation spend, and driving a safe environment for clients and Care Professionals (CPs). You'll mine large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to surface the risk indicators that actually predict incidents and injuries, then design systemic solutions—built on technology, not just process—that hold up as we grow into new markets and service lines. You'll own the full workers' compensation lifecycle, building durable programs that manage costs more effectively. You will also partner with Product and Engineering to build tools and automation that make safety a scalable advantage rather than a manual, reactive function.

The right candidate has built and scaled safety, trust & safety, or risk programs inside a technology-enabled, high-growth, distributed workforce, using data and product thinking to solve problems at scale. You're equally comfortable diving into the details of a single incident investigation and stepping back to design company-wide systems. You think outside the box rather than defaulting to "industry best practice"—you can identify the handful of activities that actually move injury and cost outcomes, build the case for whichever investment they require, and influence outcomes across distributed teams who don't report to you. You can also translate messy, imperfect data into a clear, credible story for leadership.

This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S. You'll manage your team remotely, so strong written communication and remote coaching skills are essential.

**As a Director of Safety at Honor, you will:**

**Safety Program Leadership**

* Own the safety operating model and architecture, balancing quick fixes with the larger structural changes the business needs as it scales.
* Build systemic solutions that address common in-home care hazards: environmental safety, mobility issues, infection control, client behavior, and more.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to build tools, automation, and product features that reduce risk, and make the case for the investment they require.
* Develop programs to build a culture of safety among Care Professionals and HQ employees.

**Workers' Compensation & Incident Management**

* Own the outcome of reducing workers' compensation spend, with end-to-end accountability for strategy and case management.
* Use data to find the levers that reduce claim cost and cycle time, and build durable programs and tooling that manage costs more effectively when injuries do occur, keeping claims on track at scale.
* Own vendor management and evaluate alternative models.
* Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis, and turn findings into corrective action plans that prevent recurrence.
* Maintain accurate incident records and reporting for leadership.
* Forecast reserves, build forward-looking budgets, and communicate financial impact to leadership. • Ensure compliance with OSHA and state-specific home care regulations.

**Data & Culture**

* Own the metrics that make safety and claims performance visible and enable early intervention.
* Communicate complex and imperfect data clearly to leadership, presenting findings and recommendations—including business cases for new investment—in terms executives can act on.
* Influence outcomes across distributed, cross-functional teams—franchise operators, field leaders, Product, and Engineering—who don't report to you directly.

**Leadership Principles We'll Assess in This Role**

* **Balance Incremental and Radical Change:** You know when to close the gap with a quick fix and when the data says to rethink the safety or claims model entirely. You push for durable, technology-enabled programs and you're willing to think outside the box and embrace unconventional approaches when a conventional fix won't hold.
* **Think Systemically:** You consider how a safety intervention ripples across markets, franchise operators, Care Pros, and clients before you act, and you build systemic solutions that leverage technology rather than one-off fixes. You identify the handful of activities that actually move injury rates and workers' compensation spend, rather than defaulting to "industry best practice."
* **Fly High & Dive Deep:** You work with large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to find the risk indicators hiding in the noise, and you know when to dive into the details of a single claim or incident versus stepping back to run the function at scale. You audit when the data and what you're hearing from the field don't match.
* **Drive Impact:** You own the outcome of reducing workers' compensation spend and building a safer environment for clients and Care Professionals—measured by injury rate and severity reduction, not activity. You communicate complex and imperfect data clearly to leadership and influence outcomes across distributed, cross-functional teams who don't report to you.

**We're Looking for You to Bring**

* 8+ years in safety, risk, trust & safety, or operations leadership, with a track record of scaling programs inside a fast-growing, technology-enabled, distributed workforce (delivery, rideshare, e-commerce fulfillment, on-demand services, logistics).
* Strong data skills (SQL, analytics, dashboarding) and a track record of working with large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to identify risk indicators, find root causes, and prioritize investment.
* Experience using technology and automation—not just process and headcount—to scale safety or operational outcomes.
* Experience owning workers' compensation end-to-end: claims, return-to-work plans, and provider relationships (or comparable risk/insurance claims experience).
* A track record of building the business case for investment, communicating complex and imperfect data clearly, and winning buy-in from senior leadership.
* Experience building and managing a remote team, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent as a function scales.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence outcomes across distributed teams—from frontline staff to executives.
* Working knowledge of OSHA and related regulatory frameworks, or the ability to ramp quickly from an adjacent regulated environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience at a technology-enabled, high-growth company (DoorDash, Amazon, Chewy, Instacart, Uber, Lyft, or similar) in safety, trust & safety, risk, or operations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to ship tools or product features that reduce risk at scale.
* Familiarity with modern safety/case management software, data platforms, and BI tools.
* Experience scaling a team through a period of significant growth, including building a leadership pipeline.

*#LI-AN1*

At Honor, we put people first. Our leadership culture is guided by Leadership Principles that prioritize integrity, compassion, and excellence. We offer a unique opportunity to lead with purpose and make a meaningful impact no matter your role.

Honor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or belief.

title: Chief Commercial Officer
description:
**We are willing to consider applicants from anywhere within the US. This role requires regular travel to our facilities in Rhode Island, Iowa and Utah.**

  

The Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) is a senior executive responsible for the company’s overall commercial strategy, revenue generation, and market expansion. This role owns the end‑to‑end go‑to‑market engine, integrating Sales, Marketing, Category Management, Sales Operations, and Customer Service to drive profitable growth and long‑term brand value.

As a member of the executive leadership team, the CCO ensures alignment between market strategy, customer execution, and enterprise objectives while building scalable commercial capabilities to support growth across retail, food service, and emerging channels.

### **Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Revenue Leadership**

* Own enterprise revenue performance, growth strategy, and commercial execution across all channels.
* Develop and execute long‑term commercial strategies aligned with company objectives and financial targets.
* Lead pricing, trade strategy, channel prioritization, and portfolio optimization.
* Identify new market, channel, and customer growth opportunities.

  

**Sales Leadership**

* Lead national and regional sales organizations, including directors, managers, and account teams.
* Establish clear sales strategies, targets, forecasts, and performance metrics.
* Drive disciplined pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and CRM adoption.
* Build and maintain executive‑level relationships with key customers, brokers, and strategic partners.

  

**Marketing & Brand Leadership**

* Oversee marketing strategy, brand positioning, and integrated marketing execution.
* Ensure alignment between brand strategy, sales priorities, and customer programs.
* Guide product launches, trade marketing, promotions, and customer activation strategies.
* Own the marketing budget and ensure ROI accountability across initiatives.

  

**Category, Insights & Commercial Analytics**

* Leverage category management, consumer insights, and analytics to inform strategy and selling narratives.
* Ensure data‑driven decision‑making across pricing, promotions, innovation, and portfolio management.
* Align insights, forecasting assumptions, and customer strategies with Integrated Planning & Execution.

  

**Sales Operations & Customer Experience**

* Oversee sales operations, customer service, and commercial process design.
* Ensure order‑to‑cash execution, service levels, and customer satisfaction align with commercial commitments.
* Standardize tools, reporting, governance, and performance management across the commercial organization.

  

**Cross‑Functional & Executive Partnership**

* Partner closely with Operations, Integrated Planning, Finance, and Product teams to ensure executable commercial commitments.
* Serve as a key contributor to enterprise strategy, S&OP alignment, and executive decision‑making.
* Build scalable commercial systems, teams, and governance to support growth and complexity.

### **Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Proven executive leadership in commercial, sales, or go‑to‑market roles.
* Strong strategic, financial, and analytical capabilities.
* Deep understanding of sales, marketing, customer strategy, and revenue management.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead complex, cross‑functional organizations and drive alignment without silos.

### **Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field required.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in sales, marketing, or commercial roles.
* Prior executive‑level commercial leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Food manufacturing, CPG, or omni‑channel experience preferred.

### **Working Conditions:**

* Office and travel‑based role with regular customer and internal leadership engagement.
* Travel as required to support key accounts, teams, and strategic initiatives.
* Flexible hours may be required to support business priorities.

title: Director of Marketing
description:
CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Director of Channel Partnerships & Business Development to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don't improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization's security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

CyberSheath is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Marketing to build and lead a high-performing marketing function during a pivotal period of market growth and increasing CMMC adoption. This leader will own the development and execution of an integrated marketing strategy that strengthens brand authority, creates qualified pipeline, accelerates revenue, and positions CyberSheath as the trusted cybersecurity compliance partner for the Defense Industrial Base.

The Director of Marketing will translate complex cybersecurity, regulatory, and technical concepts into clear, credible, audience-specific messaging that resonates with executive buyers, IT and security leaders, compliance stakeholders, and operational leaders at defense contractors. This person will combine strategic rigor with operational excellence—setting the go-to-market plan while remaining close to campaigns, content, events, demand generation, performance analytics, and sales alignment.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven B2B marketing leader with experience in cybersecurity, managed services, compliance technology, government contracting, or similarly complex technical markets. They are comfortable operating in a growth-stage, private equity-backed environment, understand long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying committees, and know how to create measurable marketing impact.

What You'll Do

Marketing Strategy and Go-to-Market

* Develop and lead CyberSheath's annual and quarterly marketing strategy in partnership with executive leadership, sales, solution engineering, customer success, and service delivery.
* Define target segments, ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, market priorities, and account-tiering strategies for defense contractors and subcontractors navigating CMMC, DFARS, and NIST SP 800-171 requirements.
* Build integrated go-to-market plans for CyberSheath's core managed compliance, managed security, managed IT, assessment, implementation, and secure enclave offerings.
* Establish clear marketing priorities, budgets, milestones, operating cadences, and performance expectations tied to company revenue objectives.
* Identify market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer pain points that should inform messaging, campaigns, sales enablement, and product/service positioning.
* Support market expansion and new-service launches with disciplined positioning, audience targeting, launch planning, campaign execution, and performance measurement.

Demand Generation and Revenue Marketing

* Own the demand-generation engine from awareness through opportunity creation, working closely with Sales to drive pipeline quality, velocity, conversion, and revenue contribution.
* Create and optimize multi-channel campaigns across digital advertising, search, email nurture, webinars, content syndication, events, partner marketing, social media, and account-based marketing.
* Design programs that engage key buying-committee members, including CEOs, COOs, CFOs, CISOs, CIOs, IT leaders, compliance leaders, program managers, and operations executives.
* Partner with Sales leadership to define lead stages, service-level agreements, qualification criteria, routing processes, follow-up expectations, and closed-loop reporting.
* Build account-based marketing programs for priority accounts, strategic verticals, and high-value partner ecosystems.
* Develop nurture paths that educate prospective customers on compliance urgency, business risk, assessment readiness, remediation needs, and the operational requirements of maintaining CMMC compliance over time.
* Continuously test audience, channel, message, offer, and conversion-path hypotheses to improve marketing efficiency and pipeline outcomes.

Brand, Messaging, and Content

* Own CyberSheath's brand strategy, voice, positioning, messaging architecture, and narrative across external and internal-facing marketing assets.
* Ensure CyberSheath clearly communicates its differentiation as a specialized, end-to-end cybersecurity compliance partner for defense contractors rather than a generalist technology or security provider.
* Lead development of high-value thought leadership, including executive articles, regulatory explainers, blogs, guides, case studies, solution briefs, webinars, customer stories, analyst-facing content, and event presentations.
* Translate highly technical and regulatory subject matter into accessible, commercially relevant content without sacrificing accuracy or credibility.
* Partner with internal subject-matter experts to develop compelling perspectives on CMMC 2.0, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, secure CUI environments, managed security, assessment readiness, and continuous compliance.
* Maintain a high editorial standard and a consistent content calendar that supports organic demand, customer education, sales enablement, search visibility, and executive thought leadership.
* Oversee website messaging, conversion paths, content governance, SEO priorities, and user experience improvements.

Product and Sales Enablement

* Partner with Sales, Solution Engineering, and Service Delivery to sharpen service positioning, customer value propositions, competitive differentiation, and proof points.
* Develop sales-enablement materials such as pitch decks, battlecards, solution briefs, case studies, industry-specific messaging, objection-handling resources, and customer presentation templates.
* Equip revenue teams with clear, current, and consistent messaging for every stage of the buyer journey.
* Create mechanisms to capture and distribute market intelligence from prospects, customers, partners, competitors, and frontline revenue teams.
* Support customer marketing initiatives, including advocacy, testimonials, referral programs, case studies, and expansion campaigns.

Events, Partnerships, and Field Marketing

* Refine CyberSheath's strategy for industry events, trade shows, conferences, webinars, and executive programs relevant to the DIB, defense contracting, cybersecurity, compliance, and government technology markets.
* Ensure events are planned against measurable objectives, including target-account engagement, meeting generation, pipeline influence, partner activation, and revenue impact.
* Build co-marketing programs with strategic technology, channel, and ecosystem partners, including Microsoft and other organizations serving the compliance and defense-contractor market.
* Identify opportunities for CyberSheath executives and subject-matter experts to build visibility through speaking engagements, contributed content, media opportunities, and industry participation.

Analytics, Operations, and Team Leadership

* Establish a metrics-driven marketing operating model that measures awareness, engagement, marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced pipeline, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, campaign ROI, pipeline velocity, and revenue contribution.
* Build and maintain reliable dashboards and executive reporting that clearly communicate marketing performance, key insights, risks, and recommended actions.
* Manage marketing technology, data hygiene, attribution, campaign operations, and budget discipline in partnership with Revenue Operations and other internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate and optimize the marketing technology stack, vendors, agencies, freelancers, and internal resources to ensure efficient execution.
* Hire, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing marketing team as the organization grows.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, customer-centric culture that values speed, quality, experimentation, commercial impact, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6 to 12 months, the Director of Marketing will be expected to:

* Establish a clear, differentiated, and consistent market narrative for CyberSheath and its service portfolio.
* Implement an integrated demand-generation strategy that produces a predictable flow of qualified opportunities.
* Strengthen alignment between Marketing, Sales, Solution Engineering, and Customer Success around target accounts, lead management, messaging, and pipeline goals.
* Improve visibility into marketing performance through practical, trusted funnel and revenue reporting.
* Elevate CyberSheath's thought-leadership presence in the CMMC, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, and broader DIB cybersecurity compliance market.
* Build a scalable content engine that supports organic growth, outbound sales efforts, customer education, and partner engagement.
* Improve conversion across core marketing journeys, including website engagement, webinar registration, gated-content conversion, demo requests, assessment inquiries, and sales-accepted leads.
* Establish a repeatable field, event, and partner-marketing framework tied to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including 3+ years in a marketing leadership role.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable pipeline, revenue, and market growth.
* Experience marketing complex B2B services, technology solutions, cybersecurity offerings, managed services, compliance solutions, SaaS, or enterprise IT services.
* Strong command of demand generation, account-based marketing, content strategy, digital marketing, field marketing, campaign operations, and marketing analytics.
* Experience supporting sales organizations with long, complex sales cycles and multiple economic, technical, and operational stakeholders.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into customer-focused positioning, messaging, and content.
* Strong executive communication, presentation, writing, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience managing budgets, agencies, vendors, and marketing technology platforms.
* Track record of building and leading high-performing teams in fast-moving, growth-oriented environments.
* Analytical mindset and fluency with funnel metrics, attribution, conversion analysis, pipeline reporting, and campaign performance optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in cybersecurity, cybersecurity compliance, managed security services, managed IT services, GRC, risk management, or regulated technology markets.
* Familiarity with the Defense Industrial Base, federal contracting, CMMC 2.0, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, FedRAMP, CUI, or government cloud environments.
* Experience marketing to defense contractors, manufacturers, engineering firms, federal contractors, or regulated mid-market organizations.
* Experience working in a private equity-backed or high-growth business environment.
* Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, web analytics, SEO, paid media, intent-data, ABM, and attribution tools.
* Experience launching services, entering new markets, repositioning a brand, or scaling a marketing organization.

Work Environment

* Fully remote role with occasional travel for industry events and offsite meetings

title: Director, Marketing
description:

Location: Remote  
Reports To: VP, Marketing  
  
**About PMV Pharma**  
PMV Pharma is a precision oncology company dedicated to transforming the treatment of cancers driven by p53 mutations. Building on more than four decades of groundbreaking p53 research, we are advancing novel small molecule therapies designed to address significant unmet need for patients with cancer.  
  
As we prepare for our first commercial launch, we are building a team of entrepreneurial, collaborative leaders who are energized by the opportunity to help bring an important new therapy to patients and establish the foundation for PMV Pharma's future growth.

The Director, Marketing will play a pivotal role in shaping the U.S. launch of rezatapopt. Reporting to the Vice President, Marketing, this individual will lead healthcare professional (HCP) marketing strategy and execution, helping translate brand strategy into impactful customer engagement, educational initiatives, and launch-ready promotional programs.  
This is a highly visible role that offers the opportunity to help build commercial capabilities within a growing oncology company preparing for its first product launch. **HCP Strategy & Launch Leadership**

* Drive customer insight generation, segmentation, and engagement strategies across key oncology stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve patient identification, biomarker testing, and treatment adoption.
* Translate market insights, clinical developments, and competitive intelligence into actionable commercial recommendations.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support launch planning, readiness, and execution.

  
**Brand & Customer Engagement**

* Lead peer-to-peer education programs and other customer engagement activities.

* Monitor performance and optimize programs using customer feedback and data-driven insights.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Sales, Insights & Analytics, Regulatory, Legal/Compliance, and agency partners.
* Serve as a key marketing lead supporting launch readiness activities and milestone execution.
* Identify risks, solve problems proactively, and help establish scalable commercial processes as PMV Pharma prepares for commercialization.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical marketing experience, including oncology, hematology, and/or rare disease.
* Experience supporting a U.S. pharmaceutical product launch, including pre-launch planning and HCP strategy development.
* Experience developing HCP messaging, promotional campaigns, and customer engagement programs.
* Strong strategic, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence effectively in a matrix environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in biomarker-driven oncology and an understanding of genomic testing pathways.

description:
**Description**

**Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000**

**About Designs for Health**  
Designs for Health is a trusted leader in the nutraceutical industry, known for delivering high-quality, research-driven nutritional products that support better health outcomes. For more than 30 years, we have combined scientific integrity, innovation, and a strong commitment to quality to earn the confidence of practitioners and customers alike.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Senior CRM Marketing Operations Analyst to serve as the functional owner and power user for Marketing's use of HubSpot. This remote role combines CRM operations, marketing analytics, and email and SMS execution to support business-to-business (B2B), patient-focused business-to-consumer (B2C), and direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels.

The analyst owns Marketing-facing HubSpot processes, workflows, audiences, dashboards, campaign operations, and user enablement while partnering with Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative, Sales, IT, and other business teams. The role collaborates with the Senior CRM Sales Operations Analyst on shared customer and account data, lifecycle definitions, lead handoffs, integrations, and cross-functional reporting. The role also connects sales outcomes with customer insights while providing analysis, segmentation, and measurement support to campaign and lifecycle strategy owners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional owner, senior power user, and subject matter expert for Marketing's use of HubSpot, including marketing processes, properties, lists, workflows, reports, dashboards, documentation, and usage standards.
* Analyze CRM, campaign, customer, and marketing-engagement data across B2B, patient-focused B2C, and DTC channels to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights.
* Build and maintain Marketing-facing HubSpot reports, dashboards, and performance summaries for Brand, Marketing, Customer Service, and leadership stakeholders; collaborate with the Sales CRM counterpart on shared funnel and revenue reporting.
* Coordinate with Brand Leads to define and maintain the strategic email and SMS content calendar, campaign schedule, automated flows, and related operational requirements.
* Coordinate with Brand Leads, copywriters, and Creative partners to move email and SMS content through development and ensure required copy, creative assets, audience criteria, and campaign details are ready for execution.
* Build, schedule, quality-check, and execute email and SMS campaigns and automated flows in HubSpot and connected tools, ensuring accurate audiences, links, timing, and tracking.
* Measure email and SMS performance, audience engagement, lead quality, conversion activity, and customer lifecycle outcomes and translate results into actionable recommendations.
* Develop and refine customer segments, targeting logic, campaign lists, suppression criteria, and audience-performance analysis in partnership with Brand Leads and other marketing stakeholders.
* Maintain and improve the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of Marketing-owned CRM data, including audience, consent, campaign, engagement, and marketing-touchpoint information; coordinate changes to shared contact and company data with the Sales CRM counterpart.
* Own Marketing's business requirements and operational support for HubSpot integrations with marketing automation, business intelligence, and other connected systems; coordinate shared integrations and data flows with the Sales CRM counterpart, IT, Data, and system owners.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Marketing-facing CRM data discrepancies, workflow issues, integration errors, and reporting inconsistencies; partner with the Sales CRM counterpart and technical owners when issues affect shared data or processes.
* Establish and improve governance for Marketing-owned HubSpot processes, including audience and consent standards, naming conventions, campaign tracking, workflow documentation, and marketing data quality; jointly maintain shared lifecycle and handoff definitions with Sales.
* Provide HubSpot guidance, training, and documentation for Marketing users that promote adoption, consistent campaign practices, data discipline, and reliable decision-making.
* Collaborate with the broader Marketing team to support departmental initiatives, projects, and evolving business priorities as needed.

**Competency**

* **HubSpot Expertise:** Applies advanced platform knowledge to reporting, segmentation, workflows, email and SMS execution, data quality, integrations, and user enablement.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Interprets campaign, customer, CRM, and sales data and translates findings into practical recommendations.
* **Marketing Operations Acumen:** Understands email and SMS calendars, content workflows, campaign execution, audience segmentation, customer journeys, and performance measurement.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Keeps Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative partners, and technical stakeholders aligned on requirements, timing, dependencies, and execution readiness.
* **Data Accuracy & Governance:** Maintains strong attention to detail and promotes clean, structured, well-governed customer data.
* **Systems Thinking:** Understands how customer data flows across HubSpot and connected marketing, sales, ERP, and reporting platforms.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Works effectively across Marketing, Sales, IT, Data, and other business teams and establishes clear ownership for shared CRM processes.
* **Problem Solving:** Investigates root causes and recommends practical improvements to marketing data, campaign workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* **Process Orientation:** Creates repeatable practices, clear documentation, and consistent standards for CRM analytics and operations.
* **Adaptability:** Adjusts effectively to changing business priorities, evolving systems, and fast-moving marketing needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM operations, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, marketing analytics, customer data, or campaign execution and reporting.
* Required advanced, hands-on HubSpot experience, including reports and dashboards, segmentation, workflows, properties, lifecycle stages, data quality, email and SMS execution, and connected applications.
* Experience coordinating email and SMS content calendars, automated flows, audience segmentation, campaign quality assurance, scheduling, execution, and performance reporting.
* Experience coordinating content development with Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative teams, and other stakeholders while managing campaign requirements and timelines.
* Experience supporting CRM integrations, monitoring data flows, and troubleshooting synchronization or data-quality issues across connected systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel and/or Google Sheets; experience with Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or a similar business intelligence tool is a plus.
* Working knowledge of CRM data structures, lead and customer lifecycle stages, marketing funnels, email and SMS campaign tracking, and customer segmentation.
* Ability to analyze, synthesize, and present complex CRM, campaign, and customer data in clear business language and translate stakeholder questions into reporting, segmentation, workflow, and data solutions.
* Experience partnering with Sales Operations on lifecycle definitions, lead handoffs, shared data governance, integrations, and cross-functional reporting is preferred.
* Understanding of data privacy, CRM governance, and email and SMS marketing compliance considerations, including CAN-SPAM and related best practices.
* Experience in nutraceuticals, CPG, healthcare, wellness, or another regulated or quality-focused environment is preferred.

**Benefits**

* You receive a competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
* You benefit from health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
* You receive a monthly product stipend to support your personal health journey.
* You have access to paid time off and company holidays.
* You work in a collaborative and supportive team environment.

**Physical Demands**

This position is primarily sedentary, requiring regular computer use and communication. Some tasks may involve moving within the office environment or occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

**Privacy**

Your application for this position is subject to Designs for Health's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Workforce Members. Designs for Health does not sell your personal information, nor does Designs for Health share it for purposes of cross-context behavioral advertising.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging**

Designs for Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can grow and thrive. Our employees form meaningful and often life-long connections while working at Designs for Health. We are all passionate about our mission of designing a well world together.

Sr. Director of Marketing Operations

description:

Possesses broad accountability to effectively coach, collaborate, and consult with FOs and their team on building and sustaining profitable restaurants that operate in a manner consistent with Jack in the Box vision, strategies and brand standards. **KEY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Monitors integration/coordination with other initiatives, proactively anticipates and addresses implementation concerns, formulates communication plans, confers with appropriate Company resources as needed, provides new initiatives training, and confirms operational readiness. Uses sound operational knowledge to inform and educate FOs of their obligations to the Company and influence them in the benefits of executing brand systems, processes, and standards to enhance the guest experience and loyalty.

Provides candid feedback to FOs on ways to continuously improve the financial and operational strength of their business. Documents discussions, commitments, next steps, and follows-up.

title: Director, Editorial and Engagement
description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington, D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

**What You'll Do**
==================

CATF works to accelerate the solutions needed to achieve a zero-emissions future. As a senior leader within the Communications & Marketing team, you will shape how CATF tells its story, elevates its ideas and experts, and engages the audiences that can help turn climate and energy solutions into real-world impact.

You will bring together institutional storytelling, executive communications, strategic events, media relations, and other important communications opportunities. Working across CATF, you will help determine which stories we tell, where and how we show up, and how our communications support organizational priorities.

This role will build an integrated editorial and engagement strategy that connects CATF's expertise with policymakers, industry leaders, donors, media, and other influential audiences.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Editorial Strategy & Institutional Storytelling** – Develop and carry out CATF's organization-wide editorial strategy and content calendar, turning organizational priorities and technical expertise into clear, compelling stories for priority audiences.
* **Messaging, Voice & Editorial Standards** – Maintain CATF's organizational messaging, editorial standards, voice, and style guidance so communications are accurate, accessible, consistent, and aligned with CATF's brand.
* **Flagship Content Leadership** – Lead or guide major institutional content, including CATF's annual report, organizational and program milestones, impact case studies, and other high-profile content.
* **Strategic Events & External Engagement** – Develop an organization-wide approach to priority events and engagements, including conferences, climate weeks, convenings, speaking opportunities, roundtables, executive engagements, and CATF-led events. Help determine the audience, messaging, speakers, content, and communications strategy for each opportunity.
* **Executive Communications & Thought Leadership** – Develop communications strategies for CATF executives and senior experts. Identify opportunities and produce speeches, opinion pieces, commentary, presentations, talking points, and other executive communications.
* **Media Relations & Reputation Building** – Work with Communications & Marketing colleagues to build relationships with influential journalists and outlets, elevate CATF's experts, and provide communications counsel during major media moments and sensitive or reputational issues.
* **Integrated Content & Engagement Planning** – Connect CATF's editorial, media, executive communications, and event strategies through an integrated planning process tied to organizational priorities and audience needs.
* **People Leadership & Team Development** – Supervise, coach, and develop communications staff. Set clear priorities and standards while supporting independent judgment, collaboration, and professional growth.

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

You are an experienced communications leader, writer, editor, convener, and strategist who understands how strong ideas become useful stories, conversations, and engagements. You can make complex climate, energy, technical, and policy issues clear without losing important context.

You bring sound editorial judgment and a collaborative leadership style. You can advise senior leaders, develop staff, and build alignment across functions, cultures, geographies, and time zones.

### **Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* 10–15 years of progressively responsible experience in strategic communications, editorial leadership, media relations, journalism, public affairs, external engagement, or a related field.
* Strong English-language writing, editing, and storytelling skills, including experience translating complex technical or policy issues into clear communications.
* Demonstrated expertise in editorial strategy, institutional storytelling, organizational messaging, and high-profile content.
* Significant experience developing executive communications and thought leadership, including speeches, opinion pieces, commentary, presentations, talking points, or other executive-level content.
* Experience developing proactive media relations strategies, working directly with journalists and editors, and advising on sensitive, rapid-response, or reputational communications.
* Experience developing strategic events and external engagements, including conferences, convenings, executive engagements, speaking opportunities, or similar forums.

title: Regional Marketing Director
description:
**About Summit:**

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit's core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit's team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit's clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

**Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)**

* HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

* HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

* HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

**Colorectal Cancer (CRC)**

* HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

*Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China's National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.*

**Job Title:** Regional Marketing Director

**Department:** US Marketing

**Location:** Remote-Field

  

**REGIONAL MARKETING DIRECTOR**

**Overview of Role:**

The Regional Marketing Director will play a critical role in supporting the successful commercialization of Summit Therapeutics' oncology portfolio by developing and executing regional marketing strategies and customer engagement initiatives that align with the Company's overall brand and commercial strategy.

The Regional Marketing Director will serve as a key partner to the field organization, Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate national brand strategies into impactful regional execution. This role will develop differentiated engagement strategies for key customers and thought leaders, leverage customer insights to enable highly personalized interactions, and support congress, advisory board, and promotional speaker initiatives.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute regional marketing strategies and educational initiatives that align with national brand strategy, commercial objectives, and the evolving needs of the oncology marketplace.

* Partner cross-functionally to identify customer insights and regional market dynamics and translate those insights into actionable recommendations for the broader commercial organization.
* Support the identification, recruitment, contracting, and execution of regional and national commercial advisory boards, ensuring appropriate planning, coordination, and execution in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
* Develop and execute national and regional congress strategies and plans, with a particular focus on Tier 1 and Tier 2 congresses, to maximize customer engagement, educational opportunities, and commercial impact.
* Partner with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders to develop pre-, during-, and post-congress engagement strategies and ensure effective follow-up with priority customers and thought leaders.
* Support the recruitment, education, contracting, and execution of the Promotional Speakers Program, working closely with internal stakeholders to ensure effective and compliant program execution.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to ensure coordinated regional execution.
* Create and participate in regular regional insight-sharing forums with the field organization to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market dynamics, and emerging opportunities and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Serve as a key conduit between the field organization and the broader Commercial organization, ensuring regional customer insights inform national marketing strategy and execution.
* Ensure all regional marketing activities and customer engagements are executed in accordance with Company policies, applicable laws and regulations, and established compliance requirements.
* All other duties as assigned

**Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare marketing, with demonstrated experience supporting commercial products and/or launches.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing regional marketing strategies and customer engagement plans within the U.S. pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Experience working within oncology is required with lung cancer experience preferred
* Demonstrated understanding of the U.S. healthcare environment and experience engaging with National and Regional Thought Leaders and other key healthcare stakeholders.
* Experience supporting commercial advisory boards, speaker programs, congress strategy/execution, and other customer engagement initiatives.

title: Director of Production
description:
**Keep Growing with Nutrafol**
------------------------------

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients - and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too - by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

#### **About you:**

Nutrafol's in-house Creative team makes everything from brand campaigns and product photography to performance ads, social content, and retail assets. As our Director of Production, you'll own how all of that work from a photography, casting and film standpoint gets made: the budgets, expenses. the schedules, the partners, and the shoot days.

This is a senior individual contributor role to start. You won't have direct reports at first. Instead, you'll lead through a network of production companies, agencies, photographers, directors, and freelancers, and through close partnership with our in-house creatives. You'll build the production function from the ground up, set the standards, and help shape how the team grows.

#### **What You'll Do:**

**Own production end to end**

* Lead production for all photo, video, and content shoots across brand, performance marketing, social, e-commerce, and retail.
* Take projects from brief to delivery: scoping, bidding, pre-production, on-set leadership, post-production, and final asset handoff.
* Act as producer on key shoots, and make sure every other shoot has the right producer.

**Manage budgets and partners**

* Build and manage the annual production budget, plus a budget for each project. Track actuals and report on spend to the SVP, Creative.
* Find, vet, and manage a roster of production companies, agencies, directors, photographers, editors, post houses, and freelance crew.
* Run bids, negotiate rates and contracts, and get the most value out of every dollar without lowering the quality of the work.
* Work with Legal and Procurement on SOWs, vendor agreements, and payments.

**Build the operating model**

* Design and run the production calendar across all creative work, balancing what the business needs with the team's capacity.
* Create repeatable workflows, templates, and best practices: production books, call sheets, approval steps, and delivery specs.
* Find ways to make more content more efficiently, such as shoots that serve several channels at once, modular content systems, and in-house studio capabilities.
* Look at and adopt new tools, including AI-assisted production and post-production workflows, where they make the work better or faster.

**Protect the brand and the business**

* Manage talent, model, and influencer usage rights, releases, and renewals. Keep a clear record of where and how long each asset can run.
* Make sure productions follow union rules (SAG-AFTRA and others where they apply), location permits, insurance, and on-set safety.
* Partner with Legal and Regulatory early in the process so that claims, testimonials, and before-and-after content meet our standards for a health and wellness brand.
* Oversee how finished assets are organized, labeled, and stored in our DAM so the whole company can find and use them.

**Partner across the company**

* Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Designers, Copywriters, and Brand teams so the work looks the way it was meant to.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-commerce, Retail, and Product Marketing to understand what assets they need and when.
* Bring production feasibility, cost, and timing into the conversation early, during concept development.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 10+ years of production experience, with at least 3 years at a senior producer, head of production, or director level.
* Experience at an in-house brand team, a creative agency, or a production company. Ideally a mix.
* A track record of producing large-scale photo and video campaigns as well as high-volume content for performance and social channels.
* Strong budget management skills, with experience owning a multimillion-dollar annual production budget.
* A deep network of production partners, crew, and talent, and the judgment to match the right partner to each project.
* Working knowledge of talent contracts, usage rights, union rules, and production insurance.
* Experience setting up production processes and systems where none existed.
* Clear, calm communication with creatives, executives, and vendors, especially when plans change on set.
* Comfort leading through influence. You get things done without direct reports.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in beauty, wellness, CPG, or another regulated category where claims and before-and-after imagery need legal review.
* Experience building or running an in-house studio.
* Familiarity with project management and DAM tools (e.g., Airtable, Asana, Monday, Bynder, Frame.io).
* Experience growing a production team over time.

Nutrafol takes into consideration a wide range of factors in final compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package.

Salary Range:

$160,000 - $170,000 USD

#### **Perks & Benefits**

* Fully remote work experience
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package, including FSA/HSA program
* 401K with employer match
* Quarterly Bonus Program
* Flexible PTO
* Two company-wide wellness breaks every day
* Free lunch on us every Tuesday and Thursday via Seamless/Grubhub
* Monthly wellness stipend
* Monthly internet stipend
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Annual learning & development stipend
* Free meditation app membership (Headspace)
* Free monthly Nutrafol subscription
* Pet insurance discounts and benefits

description:

===============

The **Director of Cokesbury Kids** is the designated team leader for the strategic and daily operations and planning for UMPH-published Cokesbury Kids programs, with accountability for the performance of the business unit team in meeting the needs of markets served by the programs, improving present processes, developing new processes to accomplish the work of the team, and working with other internal units in support of financial goals for Cokesbury Kids. The incumbent supervises and coordinates Cokesbury Kids product planning, theme and content development, manuscript acquisition, editorial development, marketing, and business planning of Cokesbury Kids resources to serve The United Methodist Church and other markets.

**ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT & AREAS OF IMPACT**
============================================

**Reporting Relationship & Peers**
----------------------------------

Reports to the Associate Publisher, as do:

* Associate Editor
* Associate Editor / Project Coordinator
* Cokesbury Kids Team Lead
* Editorial Assistant
* Lead Editor
* Media Editor

* Production Manager

* Indirect supervision (1)

* Various contractors

**Areas of Impact (as applicable)**
-----------------------------------

### *DEPARTMENT OPERATING BUDGET*

* $50,000 (portion of department budget this position administers)

**RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE**
============================

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

### ***PRIMARY***

* Leads the Cokesbury Kids team in developing and implementing an annual publishing, marketing, and promotional plan to assure achievement of financial budgets, targets, and objectives for sales, expenses, cost of goods, inventory levels, and net contribution.
* Directs and guides the editorial stages of production for the 100-plus components of VBS from development through point of delivery of the product to the printer. Writes original content, directs editing of manuscripts, and manages their development through the editorial production process by analyzing structure and content, comparing formats and appeal to competitor products, and appraising and improving readability and format. Leads the editorial team in monitoring the biblical and theological quality and consistency of within Cokesbury Kids resources (with an emphasis on VBS), looking for both compatibility with United Methodist teachings and breadth that allows broader use by other mainline denominations.
* Leads the theme and content development process for VBS and related programs, including customer summits and focus groups, story consultations, and other forms of research.
* Coordinates with the Business Manager, Marketing Manager, Buyer, and editorial staff to create business plans that present product lines designed to meet sales and cost-of-goods targets, optimize inventory, and offer new products that fit audience market interests.

### ***SECONDARY***

* Works with the Marketing Manager to plan and implement competitive promotion and sales campaigns for Cokesbury Kids programs.
* Conducts or supervises product-related workshops and training events as needed.

*These essential job functions are* *not* *intended to cover all work details or the occasional performance of other tasks as assigned by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*

**Common or Complex Problem-Solving Challenges**
------------------------------------------------

* Achieving the financial objectives for Cokesbury Kids programs in all areas
* Keeping abreast of current trends in Christian education and children’s programming within The United Methodist Church, other constituencies and markets, and secular education markets in order to produce user-friendly resources that sell and are consistent with United Methodist theological and educational standards
* Planning and developing, with the Cokesbury Kids team, dynamic programs and resources to meet or exceed customer expectations and specific UMPH sales and market-penetration goals
* Directing time and available resources to manage more than 100 VBS components through development and production, on time and within budget, while maintaining positive relationships with creators, contract editors and content developers, and internal support units and assuring a high-quality product line
* Working within UMPH-approved policies and business plans to establish schedules, achieve quality standards, and meet sales objectives for the team
* Leading the Cokesbury Kids team in developing general product-line strategies and specific proposals for Cokesbury Kids publishing
* Applying needs and interests of Cokesbury Kids market segments identified through research to product-line development

**Authority & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Authority to collaborate, plan, develop, acquire, and market a range of Cokesbury Kids products to meet editorial, financial, and sales objectives
* Authority to maintain knowledge of customer segments and marketplace trends and to cultivate specific segments in order to increase the customer base
* Authority to develop, implement, and/or review annual strategic plans and individual product-line business plans in consultation with appropriate team members and leaders to support overall UMPH operational objectives
* Accountability for collaborating, developing, and implementing an annual plan to achieve objectives for revenue, expenses, cost of goods, inventory values, inventory turn, net contribution, and other key operational and financial objectives
* Accountability for collaborating with marketing and sales as they develop and implement marketing and promotional plans to achieve financial budgets, targets, and objectives for Cokesbury Kids programs
* Accountability for meeting the editorial, financial, and sales objectives of Cokesbury Kids programs

**Regular Contacts & Stakeholders**
-----------------------------------

* Cokesbury Kids team members and other UMPH cross-functional personnel from various units; Business/Buyer team; Marketing team; Sales team; Allied Products team; Digital Production Services; Core Function Managers – provides indirect direction to the Cokesbury Kids leads, media editor, editors, production and design managers, business manager/buyer, and marketing manager

### ***EXTERNAL***

* Contract writers, editors, content developers, and producers; internal and external reviewers/evaluators; United Methodist Curriculum Resources Committee; other external partners and teams as assigned

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**
====================

**Education, Experience, & Certifications**
-------------------------------------------

### ***REQUIRED***

* Bachelor’s degree in business, English, journalism, communications, education, religion, or a related field
* At least five (5) years of experience in publishing, religious education, business management, product development, marketing, or a related field

### ***PREFERRED***

* Master’s degree
* Current or previous participation in Christian education programs within a local congregation

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of children’s ministry programs and Cokesbury Kids resources.
* Strategic leadership
* Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills and ability to manage a large cross-functional team.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to make presentations and lead workshops.
